The spec now includes the **Other charges** field everywhere a bill's money is described: [deep-interview-bill-splitter.md](.omc/specs/deep-interview-bill-splitter.md) (now v2.1).

**The rules, from your answers:**
- **Where it applies:** every bill has it, solo and both group modes. It's one field labelled "Other charges", with a % / amount switch like tax and tip.
- **Allowed values:** it's optional, and blank or 0 means none (the result then shows "Other charges 0.00"). As an amount it's 0.01–1,000,000.00, and as a % it's 0.01–100. Both allow at most 2 decimals.
- **What the % is of:** the food subtotal only, never tax or tip.
- **No tax or tip on it:** tax is never charged on other charges, and a tip is never calculated on them, whichever tip option is chosen.
- **Itemized bills:** other charges are split in proportion to each person's food, like tax and tip. Leftover cents go by largest remainder, and ties go to the first person in the list.
- **Totals:** grand total = food + tax + other charges + tip, and this is what an equal split divides.

**Spec sections I updated:**
- the main-parts table and the goal
- the limits
- a new non-goals entry: no extra charge lines, and no tax or tip on other charges
- the calculation rules: three new rules (other charges, rounding order, grand-total formula), with the rest renumbered 1–10
- the ontology tables
- the assumptions table and the transcript

**New acceptance criteria:**
- solo bills: % and amount, the "food only" base, half-up rounding, 0 meaning none, and the 1,000,000 maximum
- equal splits: three new cases
- itemized splits: three new cases, including the tie on a leftover cent
- error messages for bad amount and % values
- the old result being hidden after switching between % and amount
- reopening a saved bill with other charges

**Checks:**
- I recalculated every new example with a script, and they all add up (for example 26.00, 134.00, 54.00 / 13.50, 5.01 / 5.00).
- I searched for leftover tax and tip mentions. Only one example needed fixing, the 1,000,000 case, which didn't say what other charges was set to.

questions.question:
First, what 'removed' means. A member with balance 0.00 is just settled: they're still in the group and nothing changes. 'Removed' means someone took them OUT of the group's member list (the spec already says this is only allowed once their balance is 0.00). The question is what happens to the old bills they were part of.

Example: Omar was on 'Pizza night' (paid 30.00, his share 10.00). Later he settles up and is removed.
• Keep on old bills, marked: 'Pizza night' still shows 'Omar (removed)' as payer and participant. All totals and other members' balances stay exactly the same. Omar can't be picked for new bills.
• Keep on old bills, no mark: the same, but his name shows normally, so it's unclear he's no longer in the group.
• Delete from old bills too: Omar disappears everywhere. His 30.00 payment and 10.00 share would vanish, changing 'Pizza night' and everyone's balances, so old balances become wrong. (Not recommended: breaks the 'never a wrong result' rule.)
• Don't allow removing anyone who appears on any bill: members can only be removed if they were never on a bill.

options.label: Keep, marked (removed) (Recommended)
options.description: Old bills and balances unchanged. The name shows as 'Omar (removed)'. Can't be picked for new bills.

options.label: Keep, no mark
options.description: Old bills unchanged and the name shown normally. Can't be picked for new bills.

options.label: Only remove if never on a bill
options.description: Anyone who appears on any bill can never be removed.

options.label: Delete from old bills
options.description: Erases their part of past bills, which changes everyone's balances.

questions.question:
If a removed member comes back (e.g. Omar rejoins the friend group), what should happen?
• Restore the same member: any member can restore Omar, his old history reconnects, and the '(removed)' mark goes away.
• Add as a new member: a fresh 'Omar' is added, and his old bills stay with the removed one. Simpler, but his history is split in two.
• No coming back: removal is permanent.

options.label: Restore same member (Recommended)
options.description: Any member can restore them. One continuous history, and the mark disappears.

options.label: Add as new member
options.description: Old history stays with the removed entry.

options.label: Permanent
options.description: A removed member can never return.

questions.question:
When the removed member had an account (they had claimed their name), what happens to that account?
• Loses access: the group disappears from their list, and they can no longer open its bills or balances. Their account and solo bills are untouched.
• Read-only access: they can still view the group's history but can't add or change anything.

options.label: Loses access (Recommended)
options.description: The group disappears for them. Their account and solo bills are untouched.

options.label: Read-only access
options.description: They can still view the group's history but not change it.

The spec is updated with all four of your decisions (now v2.2): [deep-interview-bill-splitter.md](.omc/specs/deep-interview-bill-splitter.md).

**What changed:**
- **Payer:** must be one of the bill's participants. The payer list only offers ticked people, and unticking the payer shows "The payer must be one of the people on this bill".
- **Settle-ups:** can be any amount from 0.01 to 1,000,000.00, even more than is owed. Example: Sara owes Ali 13.00 and pays 20.00, so now Ali owes Sara 7.00.
- **Invite code:** created automatically with the group and never changes. There's no regenerate option. Any member can view it and copy it with a Copy button.
- **Removed members:**
  - **Settled is not removed.** A member with balance 0.00 is still a normal member. "Removed" means taken off the member list, which is only allowed at 0.00.
  - They stay on old bills as "Omar (removed)", and no totals or balances change.
  - They can't be picked for new bills or settle-ups.
  - Any member can **restore** them, with their full history.
  - A removed member with an account **loses access** to the group. Their account and solo bills are untouched.
  - Members can **leave** on their own once their balance is 0.00.
  - The activity log records removals, leaving and restores.

**Rules I added to close gaps:**
1. **Bills that include a removed member are view-only** until that member is restored. Editing them would change the balance of someone who's no longer in the group.
2. **The last member with an account can't leave or be removed.** Otherwise a group could end up with nobody able to log in.
3. **The invite code can't be used to get back in after removal.** It only lets someone claim an unclaimed, current name, so a removed person needs a current member to restore them.
4. **Group size is now 1–50 current members, instead of "2–50".** A group starts with only its creator, so "2–50" contradicted the group-creation rule.
5. **A settle-up must be between two different current members.**

Two open assumptions remain from before: there's no quick split without a group, and tax and tip % accept up to 2 decimals.

questions.question:
When the last member with an account leaves, you'd like a warning. After they confirm, what happens to the group?
• Deleted for good: the warning says "You're the last member with an account. If you leave, this group and all its bills, settle-ups and history will be permanently deleted." Leave → the group is gone; Cancel → nothing changes. Clear and simple to test.
• Kept but frozen: the group stays in the database with nobody able to open it, until someone claims a name with the invite code. Data is never lost, but there's an invisible group nobody can reach.

options.label: Deleted for good (Recommended)
options.description: Warning, then on Leave the group and all its data are permanently deleted. Cancel keeps everything.

options.label: Kept but frozen
options.description: The group stays, unreachable until someone claims a name with the invite code.

questions.question:
Must the last member with an account settle to 0.00 before leaving (and deleting the group)?
• No: the group and everyone's balances are deleted anyway, so the warning just also says "Unsettled balances will be lost".
• Yes: same rule as everyone else. They must be at 0.00 before they can leave, even though the group then disappears.

options.label: No, warn instead (Recommended)
options.description: They can leave at any balance. The warning mentions unsettled balances will be lost.

options.label: Yes, 0.00 first
options.description: The same balance rule as all members.

questions.question:
Without the restriction, what can the invite code do? Example: Omar was removed and still has his account and the code.
• Code brings removed members back: if Omar enters the code, he's restored automatically with his full history (the same as a member pressing Restore). The log says "Omar rejoined with the invite code". The code still also lets new people claim unclaimed names.
• Code brings people back AND lets anyone add themselves: the same, plus someone whose name isn't on the list can add themselves as a brand-new member. Most open, but anyone with the code can join.
• Code only claims names (as before), and removed people come back only through Restore. (This is the rule you said you don't need.)

options.label: Also restores removed (Recommended)
options.description: Entering the code restores a removed member automatically, and new people can still claim unclaimed names.

options.label: Restores + self-add new
options.description: Also lets anyone with the code add themselves as a new member.

79:6. **Equal split:** grand total (including other charges) ÷ number of participants. Leftover cents go 1 each to the first participants in list order, and the app shows who pays the extra cent.
81:   - Each item has a price and 1+ ticked participants. Its cost is split evenly between them, with leftover cents going to the first ticked people.
82:   - Tax, other charges and tip are each split separately in proportion to each participant's food subtotal. Leftover cents are assigned by largest remainder, and ties go to the first participant in list order.
89:9. **Invite code:**
90:   - Each group gets one invite code, generated automatically when the group is created. It never changes, and there is no regenerate option.
92:   - Entering the code only lets an account claim an **unclaimed, current** member. It can't add a new member, and it can't bring back a removed member.
93:10. **Removing, leaving and restoring members:**
94:   - **Settled ≠ removed.** A member with balance 0.00 is still a normal member. "Removed" means taken off the group's current member list.
95:   - Any member can remove another member, and any member can leave (remove themselves), but **only when that member's balance is exactly 0.00**.
96:   - A member can't leave or be removed if they are the last current member with an account. The message is "A group needs at least one member with an account".
97:   - Removing never changes past data. Old bills and settle-ups keep the member, shown as "Name (removed)", and every total and balance stays exactly the same.
98:   - A removed member can't be chosen as payer, participant or settle-up person on new bills or settle-ups. They don't appear in the balance list or the settle-up suggestions.
99:   - While a member is removed, any bill or settle-up that includes them is **view-only**: it can't be edited or deleted, because that would change a removed member's balance. The message is "Restore Omar to change this bill".
100:   - If the removed member had an account, they **lose access** to the group right away: it disappears from their group list, and its pages are refused even by typing the address directly. Their account and solo bills are untouched, and the link between their account and the member is kept.
101:   - The group's members page lists removed members under "Removed members", each with a **Restore** button that any current member can use. Restoring brings back the same member, with one continuous history and the "(removed)" mark gone. If they had an account, their access returns.
102:   - Restoring is refused with a clear message if the group already has 50 current members, or if a current member already has the same name.
103:   - The activity log records "X removed Omar", "Omar left" and "X restored Omar".
140:- [ ] Given three participants with 10.00 of food each and other charges 0.10, then their other-charges parts are 0.04 / 0.03 / 0.03 (the leftover cent goes to the first participant on a tie).
147:- [ ] Given I create a group with a name and a currency, then I'm its first member, I see a note that the currency can't be changed, and an invite code is generated automatically.
148:- [ ] Given I'm a current member, when I open the group's invite section, then I see the code and a Copy button that copies it. There is no option to regenerate or change it.
158:- [ ] Given Omar signs up and enters the group's invite code, when he chooses "I'm Omar", then his account is linked to that member and he sees the full group history.
160:- [ ] Given a wrong invite code, then I see "That invite code isn't valid" and join nothing.
161:- [ ] Given a valid invite code, when I enter it, then I can only choose from unclaimed, current members. Removed members and already-claimed members aren't offered.
165:- [ ] Given my own balance isn't 0.00, when I try to leave, then I see "Settle your balance before leaving" and I stay in the group.
166:- [ ] Given Omar's balance is 0.00, when any member removes him (or he leaves), then he moves to "Removed members", and the activity log records it ("X removed Omar" or "Omar left").
167:- [ ] Given Omar is removed, when I open "Pizza night" (which he paid for), then it shows "Omar (removed)" as payer and participant, and the bill's totals and all balances are exactly as before.
168:- [ ] Given Omar is removed, when I add a new bill or settle-up, then Omar isn't offered as payer, participant or settle-up person, and he isn't in the balance list or the suggestions.
169:- [ ] Given Omar is removed, when I try to edit or delete a bill or settle-up that includes him, then I see "Restore Omar to change this bill" and nothing changes.
170:- [ ] Given Omar has an account and is removed, then the group disappears from his group list, and opening its address shows that he no longer has access. His solo bills are unchanged.
171:- [ ] Given Omar is removed, when any member presses Restore, then he's a current member again with his full history and no "(removed)" mark. If he had an account, his access returns, and the log records "X restored Omar".
172:- [ ] Given the group has 50 current members, or a current member is already named Omar, when anyone tries to restore Omar, then a clear message is shown and he stays removed.
173:- [ ] Given I'm the last current member with an account, when I try to leave (or someone tries to remove me), then I see "A group needs at least one member with an account" and nothing changes.
179:- [ ] Given other charges as an amount of "abc", "-1", "0.001" or "1000000.01", then the message "Other charges must be between 0.01 and 1,000,000.00, or left empty" appears next to the field and no result is shown.
180:- [ ] Given other charges as a % of "abc", "-5", "0.001" or "100.01", then the message "Other charges must be between 0.01% and 100%, or left empty" appears next to the field and no result is shown.
204:- **Group member:** belongs to one or more friend groups, all with equal rights. Can add, edit or delete group bills and settle-ups, add name-only friends, view and copy the invite code, see balances, remove or restore members, and leave the group. Must never see groups they aren't in (including groups they were removed from), remove or leave while a balance isn't 0.00, record a bill whose payer isn't a participant, change a bill that includes a removed member, or change a group's currency.

content.text:
The spec is updated with both changes (now v2.3): [deep-interview-bill-splitter.md](.omc/specs/deep-interview-bill-splitter.md).

**Last member with an account leaving:**
- They're no longer blocked. When they press Leave, they see: "You're the last member with an account. If you leave, this group and all its bills, settle-ups and history will be permanently deleted. Unsettled balances will be lost."
- **Cancel** changes nothing. **Leave** permanently deletes the group, even if their balance isn't 0.00.
- The group disappears for everyone, its address shows "This group no longer exists", and its invite code stops working.
- Accounts, solo bills and other groups are never affected.

**Invite code:**
- The old restriction is gone. If a removed member enters the code, they're restored automatically with their full history and access, and the log records "Omar rejoined with the invite code".
- Rejoining is still refused with a clear message if the group already has 50 current members, or if a current member has the same name.
- Someone who's already a current member sees "You're already in this group".

**Two small rules I added:**
1. A new account entering the code can claim any unclaimed name, including removed ones, which are marked "(removed)". Claiming a removed name brings it back.
2. There's no separate "delete group" button. A group is only deleted when its last member with an account leaves.

I also searched the spec for old wording that conflicts with these changes, and none is left.

11	The bill splitting calculator's product docs live in `docs/` (app-roles.md, jobs-to-be-done.md, user-stories.md) or are linked from the README. Markdown, PDF, Word or Google Docs are all acceptable. Each doc must follow these rules:
12	
13	**App Roles (who uses the app)**
14	- Template: "A [role] is [who this person is and their situation]. They can [what they see and do in the app]. They must never [what the app must prevent]." The "must never" part applies only where it is relevant.
15	- One role or several is fine, but each must be a real kind of person and say how their needs differ from the other roles.
16	
17	**Jobs To Be Done (why they use it)**
18	- Template: "When [situation], I want to [motivation], so I can [expected outcome]."
19	- Each job names the role it belongs to.
20	- A job is what the person needs done whether or not the app exists: it must not mention the app or its features. If it can't be written without naming a button or screen, it's a feature, not a job.
21	
22	**User Stories with Acceptance Criteria (how the app helps)**
23	- Template: "As a [role], I want [capability], so that [benefit]."

1	# Deep Interview Spec: Bill Splitting Calculator (v2)
2	
3	## Metadata
4	- Interview ID: b7e2c1a4-5d3f-4e8a-9c21-bill-splitter-01
5	- Rounds: 19 (plus Round 0 topology check)
6	- Final Ambiguity Score: 17.6%
7	- Type: greenfield
8	- Generated: 2026-10-21 (v2 replaces the v1 spec written after Round 10; v2.1 adds the Other charges field; v2.2 settles payer, settle-up, invite code and member-removal rules; v2.3 adds group deletion by the last account holder and rejoining with the invite code)
9	- Threshold: 0.2
10	- Threshold Source: default
11	- Initial Context Summarized: no
12	- Status: PASSED — pending approval
13	
14	## Clarity Breakdown
15	| Dimension | Score | Weight | Weighted |
16	|-----------|-------|--------|----------|
17	| Goal Clarity | 0.86 | 0.40 | 0.344 |
18	| Constraint Clarity | 0.84 | 0.30 | 0.252 |
19	| Success Criteria | 0.76 | 0.30 | 0.228 |
20	| **Total Clarity** | | | **0.824** |
21	| **Ambiguity** | | | **0.176** |
22	
23	## Topology
24	| Component | Status | Description | Coverage |
25	|-----------|--------|-------------|----------|
26	| Solo bill | active | A logged-in person totals their own bill (items, tax, other charges, tip) and keeps a private history | AC-S, AC-H |
27	| Equal group split | active | A group bill (items, tax, other charges, tip) split evenly between the members who took part, cent-exact | AC-E |
28	| Itemized group split | active | Each participant pays for what they had (items can be shared) plus proportional tax, other charges and tip | AC-I |
29	| Groups (added R13) | active | Lasting friend groups: name-only or claimed members, payer, running balances, settle-ups, activity log | AC-G |
30	| Accounts (added R14) | active | In-app username/password accounts with a recovery code; no outside services | AC-A |
31	| Tech choices and setup | active | TypeScript, React, Node.js/Express, SQLite; runs locally from the README and deploys to any server | AC-T |
32	| Product docs | active | Roles, jobs and stories in the saved format, kept in line with the app | AC-D |
33	
34	## Goal
35	A self-contained web app for splitting and tracking bills:
36	- **Solo diners** total their own bills (items, tax, other charges and tip) and keep a private history.
37	- **Friends** form lasting groups. Any member can record a group bill: who paid, who took part, and whether it's split equally or by items. The app keeps exact running balances, shows the fewest payments needed to settle up, and records settle-ups.
38	
39	All money math is exact to the cent, and every invalid input gives a clear message, never a crash or a wrong result.
40	
41	## Constraints
42	- **Browsers:** current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari.
43	- **No third-party services:** the app must not depend on any external cloud or paid service (no hosted auth, hosted database, email/SMS or payment APIs). It **can** be deployed to a server. Reviewers must be able to run it locally from the README with only free software (Node.js LTS).
44	- **Accounts:** built into the app. Username + password, with passwords hashed. Sessions use secure cookies. No email anywhere.
45	- **Storage:** SQLite database file managed by the app's own server.
46	- **Modes:** Solo (personal), Group bill with Equal split, and Group bill with Itemized split. These are separate screens and rules (Round 4).
47	- **Number limits:**
48	  - Money: 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places. No negatives, letters, blanks or extra decimals.
49	  - Group size: 1–50 **current** members. A group starts with just its creator, and removed members don't count toward the 50.
50	  - Tax and tip %: 0–100, at most 2 decimal places (e.g. 12.5 or 8.25). Tax and tip amounts: 0.00–1,000,000.00.
51	  - Other charges (optional): blank, 0 or 0.00 means "no other charges". Otherwise:
52	    - as an amount: 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places
53	    - as a %: 0.01–100, at most 2 decimal places
54	    - negatives, letters and extra decimals are rejected.
55	- **Bill fields:** every bill (solo and both group modes) has the same four money parts: items, tax, **other charges** and tip. Other charges is a single field per bill, always labelled "Other charges" (for service, delivery or table fees and similar), with a % / amount switch like tax and tip.
56	- **Currency:** a display symbol only, picked from a fixed list (e.g. $, €, £, ¥, ₹, Rs), with no conversion.
57	  - Each **group** has one currency, chosen at creation and never changeable. A note says so when you choose it.
58	  - Each **solo bill** has its own currency, locked when the bill is first saved.
59	- **Math:** integer cents only, never floating-point money.
60	- **Results:** totals appear when the user presses **Calculate**. Changing any input hides the old result until Calculate is pressed again.
61	
62	## Non-Goals
63	- Currency conversion; multiple currencies in one group.
64	- Email or SMS (invites, password resets, notifications).
65	- Real payment processing (settle-ups are records only).
66	- Receipt scanning, native mobile apps, real-time push updates.
67	- Multiple payers on one bill (Round 19).
68	- Regenerating or changing a group's invite code.
69	- A quick split without a group: splitting a bill between people always happens inside a group, even for a one-off outing.
70	- Permanently deleting a member, or erasing their part of past bills.
71	- More than one other-charges line per bill, or custom labels for it.
72	- Tax on other charges, or tip on other charges.
73	
74	## Calculation Rules
75	1. **Tax:** a % (of the food subtotal) or an amount. Tax is never charged on other charges or tip.
76	2. **Other charges:** optional; a % or an amount. A % is a percentage of the **food subtotal only** (the same base as tax), never of tax or tip. Blank or 0 means 0.00 other charges, and the results still show an "Other charges 0.00" line.
77	3. **Tip:** a % or an amount. Tip may be 0. For a % tip, each bill has a "tip on" option: **food only (default)** or **food + tax**. Neither option includes other charges: a tip is never calculated on other charges.
78	4. **Rounding and order:** tax, other charges and tip are each worked out separately, in cents. Any % result is rounded half-up to the cent, so it can be 0.00 (e.g. 5% of 0.01). A "food + tax" tip uses the already-rounded tax.
79	5. **Grand total** = food subtotal + tax + other charges + tip.
80	6. **Equal split:** grand total (including other charges) ÷ number of participants. Leftover cents go 1 each to the first participants in list order, and the app shows who pays the extra cent.
81	7. **Itemized split:**
82	   - Each item has a price and 1+ ticked participants. Its cost is split evenly between them, with leftover cents going to the first ticked people.
83	   - Tax, other charges and tip are each split separately in proportion to each participant's food subtotal. Leftover cents are assigned by largest remainder, and ties go to the first participant in list order.
84	   - A participant with no items owes 0.00 (including 0.00 tax, other charges and tip).
85	8. **Group balances:**
86	   - Each group bill has one payer, and **the payer must be one of that bill's participants**. The payer list only offers ticked participants. If the payer is unticked, Calculate and Save show "The payer must be one of the people on this bill".
87	   - The payer is credited with the full grand total, and each participant (including the payer) is debited their share. So the payer's net change is grand total − their own share.
88	   - A settle-up from A to B (A pays B) credits A and debits B. A and B must be two different current members. The amount can be any valid amount (0.01–1,000,000.00, 2 decimals), **even more than A owes B**. The balances simply update, and an overpayment flips the direction of the debt.
89	   - Net balances across the group always sum to exactly 0.00.
90	9. **Invite code:**
91	   - Each group gets one invite code, generated automatically when the group is created. It never changes, and there is no regenerate option.
92	   - Any current member can view it and copy it with a Copy button.
93	   - Entering the code (while logged in) does one of the following:
94	     - **Removed member with this account:** they are **restored automatically** with their full history (the same as Restore). The log says "Omar rejoined with the invite code".
95	     - **New account:** they choose a name to claim from the group's **unclaimed** members, current or removed. Removed names are marked "(removed)", and claiming one restores it.
96	     - **Already a current member:** "You're already in this group", and nothing changes.
97	   - The code can't create a brand-new member. New names are added by a current member.
98	   - The restore limits below (50 current members, no duplicate current name) apply to rejoining with the code too.
99	10. **Removing, leaving and restoring members:**
100	   - **Settled ≠ removed.** A member with balance 0.00 is still a normal member. "Removed" means taken off the group's current member list.
101	   - Any member can remove another member, and any member can leave (remove themselves), but **only when that member's balance is exactly 0.00**. The one exception is the last member with an account, below.
102	   - **Last member with an account leaving:** when the only current member with an account presses Leave, the app warns: "You're the last member with an account. If you leave, this group and all its bills, settle-ups and history will be permanently deleted. Unsettled balances will be lost."
103	     - **Cancel:** nothing changes.
104	     - **Leave:** the whole group is permanently deleted, including its members, bills, settle-ups, activity log and invite code. Their balance doesn't need to be 0.00 first.
105	     - This only happens through leaving. Anyone else removing them would themselves have to be a current member with an account, so they could never be the last one.
106	   - Leaving or deleting never touches anyone's account or solo bills.
107	   - There is no separate "delete group" button.
108	   - Removing never changes past data. Old bills and settle-ups keep the member, shown as "Name (removed)", and every total and balance stays exactly the same.
109	   - A removed member can't be chosen as payer, participant or settle-up person on new bills or settle-ups. They don't appear in the balance list or the settle-up suggestions.
110	   - While a member is removed, any bill or settle-up that includes them is **view-only**: it can't be edited or deleted, because that would change a removed member's balance. The message is "Restore Omar to change this bill".
111	   - If the removed member had an account, they **lose access** to the group right away: it disappears from their group list, and its pages are refused even by typing the address directly. Their account and solo bills are untouched, and the link between their account and the member is kept.
112	   - The group's members page lists removed members under "Removed members", each with a **Restore** button that any current member can use. Restoring brings back the same member, with one continuous history and the "(removed)" mark gone. If they had an account, their access returns.
113	   - Restoring is refused with a clear message if the group already has 50 current members, or if a current member already has the same name.
114	   - The activity log records "X removed Omar", "Omar left", "X restored Omar" and "Omar rejoined with the invite code".
115	11. **Settle-up suggestions:** the fewest payments that bring every net balance to zero (greedy match of largest debtor to largest creditor), shown as "X pays Y amount".
116	12. **Invariant:** for every bill, the shares sum exactly to the grand total. In itemized bills, the per-person tax, other-charges and tip parts also each sum exactly to the bill's tax, other charges and tip.
117	
118	## Acceptance Criteria
119	### Accounts (AC-A)
120	- [ ] Given a new username and a valid password, when I sign up, then my account is created, a one-time recovery code is shown with a "save this now" warning, and I'm logged in.
121	- [ ] Given a username that is already taken, when I sign up, then I see "That username is taken" and no account is created.
122	- [ ] Given a wrong password, when I log in, then I see "Username or password is incorrect" (without saying which one) and I stay logged out.
123	- [ ] Given my username + recovery code + a new password, when I reset, then I can log in with the new password, the old code stops working, and a new code is shown.
124	- [ ] Given I'm logged out, when I open any bill or group page, then I'm sent to login and no data is shown.
125	- [ ] Given I'm logged in, I can never see or change another account's solo bills, or groups I'm not a member of, even by typing the address directly.
126	
127	### Solo (AC-S)
128	- [ ] Given items 12.50 and 7.50, tax 10%, other charges blank, tip 15% on food, when I press Calculate, then subtotal 20.00, tax 2.00, other charges 0.00, tip 3.00 and total 25.00 are shown.
129	- [ ] Given items 12.50 and 7.50, tax 10%, other charges 5%, tip 15% on food, when I press Calculate, then subtotal 20.00, tax 2.00, other charges 1.00, tip 3.00 and total 26.00 are shown.
130	- [ ] Given food 100.00, tax 10.00 (amount), other charges blank and tip 15% on food + tax, then the tip is 16.50 and the total is 126.50.
131	- [ ] Given food 100.00, tax 10.00 (amount), other charges 7.50 (amount) and tip 15% on food + tax, then other charges is 7.50, the tip is 16.50 (other charges are not tipped on) and the total is 134.00.
132	- [ ] Given food 100.00, tax 10% and other charges 10%, then other charges is 10.00 (a % of food only, not of food + tax).
133	- [ ] Given food 33.33 and other charges 12.5%, then other charges is 4.17 (4.16625 rounded half-up).
134	- [ ] Given other charges 0 or 0.00, then it is treated as "no other charges", shows 0.00, and causes no error.
135	- [ ] Given food 0.01, tax 0, other charges 1,000,000.00 (amount) and tip 0, then other charges is 1,000,000.00 and the total is 1,000,000.01.
136	- [ ] Given tip 0, then the tip shows 0.00 with no error.
137	- [ ] Given no items, when I press Calculate, then I see "Add at least one item" and no result.
138	
139	### Equal group split (AC-E)
140	- [ ] Given total 100.00 with 3 participants, then the shares are 33.34 / 33.33 / 33.33, the first participant is marked as paying the extra cent, and the shares sum to 100.00.
141	- [ ] Given 0 participants selected, when I press Calculate, then I see "Choose who took part" and no result (no division by zero).
142	- [ ] Given 0.01 split between 2 participants, then the shares are 0.01 and 0.00.
143	- [ ] Given food 1,000,000.00, tax 0, other charges blank and a 100% tip on food, split between 50 participants, then the grand total is 2,000,000.00, each share is 40,000.00, and the shares sum to the total.
144	- [ ] Given food 1,000,000.00, tax 0, other charges 1,000,000.00 (amount) and tip 0, split between 3 participants, then the grand total is 2,000,000.00 and the shares are 666,666.67 / 666,666.67 / 666,666.66.
145	- [ ] Given food 90.00, tax 0, other charges 10% and tip 0, split between 3 participants, then other charges is 9.00, the grand total is 99.00, and each share is 33.00.
146	- [ ] Given food 10.00 and other charges 0.01 (amount), split between 2 participants, then the grand total is 10.01 and the shares are 5.01 and 5.00.
147	
148	### Itemized group split (AC-I)
149	- [ ] Given Ali steak 40.00, Sara salad 10.00, tax 5.00, other charges blank and tip 10.00, then Ali's share is 52.00 and Sara's is 13.00.
150	- [ ] Given the same bill with other charges 2.50 (amount), then Ali pays 2.00 and Sara 0.50 of the other charges, Ali's share is 54.00, Sara's is 13.50, and they sum to the grand total of 67.50.
151	- [ ] Given three participants with 10.00 of food each and other charges 0.10, then their other-charges parts are 0.04 / 0.03 / 0.03 (the leftover cent goes to the first participant on a tie).
152	- [ ] Given a participant with no items and other charges 5.00 on the bill, then that participant's other-charges part is 0.00.
153	- [ ] Given nachos 12.00 ticked for Ali, Sara and Omar, then each is charged 4.00 for it, and 10.00 shared by 3 gives 3.34 / 3.33 / 3.33.
154	- [ ] Given an item with nobody ticked, when I press Calculate, then I see "Choose who shared this item" and no result.
155	- [ ] For any valid bill, the per-person totals sum exactly to the grand total.
156	
157	### Groups (AC-G)
158	- [ ] Given I create a group with a name and a currency, then I'm its first member, I see a note that the currency can't be changed, and an invite code is generated automatically.
159	- [ ] Given I'm a current member, when I open the group's invite section, then I see the code and a Copy button that copies it. There is no option to regenerate or change it.
160	- [ ] Given a group of 10 members, when I add a bill with 5 participants paid by one of them, then only those 5 are charged and the other 5 balances don't change.
161	- [ ] Given a bill's participants are Ali and Sara, then the payer list offers only Ali and Sara.
162	- [ ] Given Omar is chosen as payer and then unticked as a participant, when I press Calculate or Save, then I see "The payer must be one of the people on this bill" and nothing is saved.
163	- [ ] Given Sara owes Ali 13.00, when I record "Sara paid Ali 20.00", then Sara's balance is +7.00, Ali's is −7.00, and the suggestion reads "Ali pays Sara 7.00".
164	- [ ] Given a settle-up from a member to the same member, or with an amount outside 0.01–1,000,000.00, then a clear message is shown and nothing is saved.
165	- [ ] Given Ali paid 65.00 and Ali 52.00 / Sara 13.00 are the shares, then Ali's net balance is +13.00, Sara's is −13.00, and the suggestion reads "Sara pays Ali 13.00".
166	- [ ] Given net balances across the group, they always sum to exactly 0.00.
167	- [ ] Given I record "Sara paid Ali 13.00", then both balances become 0.00 and the suggestion disappears.
168	- [ ] Given I add a name-only member "Omar", then Omar can be a participant (and the payer of a bill he takes part in) right away.
169	- [ ] Given Omar signs up and enters the group's invite code, when he chooses "I'm Omar", then his account is linked to that member and he sees the full group history.
170	- [ ] Given a member already claimed by an account, another account can't claim it, and the same account can't claim two members in one group.
171	- [ ] Given a wrong invite code, then I see "That invite code isn't valid" and join nothing.
172	- [ ] Given a valid invite code and a new account, when I enter it, then I can choose from all unclaimed members. Removed ones are marked "(removed)", and already-claimed members aren't offered. There's no option to add myself as a new name.
173	- [ ] Given Omar has an account and was removed, when he enters the invite code, then he's restored automatically with his full history and access, and the log records "Omar rejoined with the invite code".
174	- [ ] Given I'm already a current member, when I enter the group's invite code, then I see "You're already in this group" and nothing changes.
175	- [ ] Given a new account claims a removed, unclaimed name, then that member is restored and linked to the account.
176	- [ ] Given the group has 50 current members, or a current member is already named Omar, when Omar enters the invite code, then a clear message is shown and he stays removed.
177	- [ ] Given any member edits or deletes a bill or settle-up, then the balances update, and the activity log shows who did it, when, and what changed.
178	- [ ] Given deleting a bill, then a confirmation is asked first. Cancel keeps the bill.
179	- [ ] Given a member whose balance isn't 0.00, when anyone tries to remove them, then I see "Settle this member's balance before removing them" and nothing changes.
180	- [ ] Given my own balance isn't 0.00 and another current member has an account, when I try to leave, then I see "Settle your balance before leaving" and I stay in the group.
181	- [ ] Given Omar's balance is 0.00, when any member removes him (or he leaves), then he moves to "Removed members", and the activity log records it ("X removed Omar" or "Omar left").
182	- [ ] Given Omar is removed, when I open "Pizza night" (which he paid for), then it shows "Omar (removed)" as payer and participant, and the bill's totals and all balances are exactly as before.
183	- [ ] Given Omar is removed, when I add a new bill or settle-up, then Omar isn't offered as payer, participant or settle-up person, and he isn't in the balance list or the suggestions.
184	- [ ] Given Omar is removed, when I try to edit or delete a bill or settle-up that includes him, then I see "Restore Omar to change this bill" and nothing changes.
185	- [ ] Given Omar has an account and is removed, then the group disappears from his group list, and opening its address shows that he no longer has access. His solo bills are unchanged.
186	- [ ] Given Omar is removed, when any member presses Restore, then he's a current member again with his full history and no "(removed)" mark. If he had an account, his access returns, and the log records "X restored Omar".
187	- [ ] Given the group has 50 current members, or a current member is already named Omar, when anyone tries to restore Omar, then a clear message is shown and he stays removed.
188	- [ ] Given I'm the last current member with an account, when I press Leave, then I see the warning that the group and all its bills, settle-ups and history will be permanently deleted and that unsettled balances will be lost.
189	- [ ] Given that warning, when I press Cancel, then nothing changes.
190	- [ ] Given that warning, when I press Leave (whatever my balance), then the group is permanently deleted. It disappears for everyone, its address shows "This group no longer exists", and its invite code becomes invalid.
191	- [ ] Given a group was deleted, then my account, my solo bills and my other groups are unchanged.
192	- [ ] Given a group with 50 current members, when I add another, then I see "A group can have at most 50 members".
193	
194	### Input validation & recovery (all modes)
195	- [ ] Given a money field containing "abc", "-5", "1.234", "1000000.01" or a blank, then a message next to the field explains the rule and no result is shown.
196	- [ ] Given tax or tip % outside 0–100, then a clear message is shown and no result.

222	## Roles (for docs)
223	- **Solo diner:** eats or shops alone and wants an accurate personal total and a private record of spending. Must never see other people's bills, or have their solo bills seen by anyone else.
224	- **Group member:** belongs to one or more friend groups, all with equal rights. Can add, edit or delete group bills and settle-ups, add name-only friends, view and copy the invite code, see balances, remove or restore members, and leave the group. Must never see groups they aren't in (including groups they were removed from), remove or leave while a balance isn't 0.00 (unless they're the last member with an account leaving, which deletes the group after a warning), record a bill whose payer isn't a participant, change a bill that includes a removed member, or change a group's currency.

251	| "Removed" = deleted | Open-assumption review | Removed ≠ settled. Removal only at balance 0.00; kept on old bills as "(removed)"; those bills are view-only; can be restored, or rejoin with the invite code; account loses access; members can leave; the last member with an account leaving deletes the group after a warning |
252	| Invite codes can be regenerated | Open-assumption review | Auto-generated once and never changes; any member can view and copy |

255	## Technical Context
256	- **Language:** TypeScript (frontend and backend), with a shared pure calculation module that works in integer cents and is used by both the page and the server.
257	- **Frontend:** React built with Vite. **Backend:** Node.js LTS + Express, serving the API and the built frontend from one process (easy to deploy).

# Deep Interview Spec: Bill Splitting Calculator (v2)

## Metadata
- Interview ID: b7e2c1a4-5d3f-4e8a-9c21-bill-splitter-01
- Rounds: 19 (plus Round 0 topology check)
- Final Ambiguity Score: 17.6%
- Type: greenfield
- Generated: 2026-10-21 (v2 replaces the v1 spec written after Round 10; v2.1 adds the Other charges field; v2.2 settles payer, settle-up, invite code and member-removal rules; v2.3 adds group deletion by the last account holder and rejoining with the invite code)
- Threshold: 0.2
- Threshold Source: default
- Initial Context Summarized: no
- Status: PASSED — pending approval

## Clarity Breakdown
| Dimension | Score | Weight | Weighted |
|-----------|-------|--------|----------|
| Goal Clarity | 0.86 | 0.40 | 0.344 |
| Constraint Clarity | 0.84 | 0.30 | 0.252 |
| Success Criteria | 0.76 | 0.30 | 0.228 |
| **Total Clarity** | | | **0.824** |
| **Ambiguity** | | | **0.176** |

## Topology
| Component | Status | Description | Coverage |
|-----------|--------|-------------|----------|
| Solo bill | active | A logged-in person totals their own bill (items, tax, other charges, tip) and keeps a private history | AC-S, AC-H |
| Equal group split | active | A group bill (items, tax, other charges, tip) split evenly between the members who took part, cent-exact | AC-E |
| Itemized group split | active | Each participant pays for what they had (items can be shared) plus proportional tax, other charges and tip | AC-I |
| Groups (added R13) | active | Lasting friend groups: name-only or claimed members, payer, running balances, settle-ups, activity log | AC-G |
| Accounts (added R14) | active | In-app username/password accounts with a recovery code; no outside services | AC-A |
| Tech choices and setup | active | TypeScript, React, Node.js/Express, SQLite; runs locally from the README and deploys to any server | AC-T |
| Product docs | active | Roles, jobs and stories in the saved format, kept in line with the app | AC-D |

## Goal
A self-contained web app for splitting and tracking bills:
- **Solo diners** total their own bills (items, tax, other charges and tip) and keep a private history.
- **Friends** form lasting groups. Any member can record a group bill: who paid, who took part, and whether it's split equally or by items. The app keeps exact running balances, shows the fewest payments needed to settle up, and records settle-ups.

All money math is exact to the cent, and every invalid input gives a clear message, never a crash or a wrong result.

## Constraints
- **Browsers:** current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari.
- **No third-party services:** the app must not depend on any external cloud or paid service (no hosted auth, hosted database, email/SMS or payment APIs). It **can** be deployed to a server. Reviewers must be able to run it locally from the README with only free software (Node.js LTS).
- **Accounts:** built into the app. Username + password, with passwords hashed. Sessions use secure cookies. No email anywhere.
- **Storage:** SQLite database file managed by the app's own server.
- **Modes:** Solo (personal), Group bill with Equal split, and Group bill with Itemized split. These are separate screens and rules (Round 4).
- **Number limits:**
  - Money: 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places. No negatives, letters, blanks or extra decimals.
  - Group size: 1–50 **current** members. A group starts with just its creator, and removed members don't count toward the 50.
  - Tax and tip %: 0–100, at most 2 decimal places (e.g. 12.5 or 8.25). Tax and tip amounts: 0.00–1,000,000.00.
  - Other charges (optional): blank, 0 or 0.00 means "no other charges". Otherwise:
    - as an amount: 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places
    - as a %: 0.01–100, at most 2 decimal places
    - negatives, letters and extra decimals are rejected.
- **Bill fields:** every bill (solo and both group modes) has the same four money parts: items, tax, **other charges** and tip. Other charges is a single field per bill, always labelled "Other charges" (for service, delivery or table fees and similar), with a % / amount switch like tax and tip.
- **Currency:** a display symbol only, picked from a fixed list (e.g. $, €, £, ¥, ₹, Rs), with no conversion.
  - Each **group** has one currency, chosen at creation and never changeable. A note says so when you choose it.
  - Each **solo bill** has its own currency, locked when the bill is first saved.
- **Math:** integer cents only, never floating-point money.
- **Results:** totals appear when the user presses **Calculate**. Changing any input hides the old result until Calculate is pressed again.

## Non-Goals
- Currency conversion; multiple currencies in one group.
- Email or SMS (invites, password resets, notifications).
- Real payment processing (settle-ups are records only).
- Receipt scanning, native mobile apps, real-time push updates.
- Multiple payers on one bill (Round 19).
- Regenerating or changing a group's invite code.
- A quick split without a group: splitting a bill between people always happens inside a group, even for a one-off outing.
- Permanently deleting a member, or erasing their part of past bills.
- More than one other-charges line per bill, or custom labels for it.
- Tax on other charges, or tip on other charges.

## Calculation Rules
1. **Tax:** a % (of the food subtotal) or an amount. Tax is never charged on other charges or tip.
2. **Other charges:** optional; a % or an amount. A % is a percentage of the **food subtotal only** (the same base as tax), never of tax or tip. Blank or 0 means 0.00 other charges, and the results still show an "Other charges 0.00" line.
3. **Tip:** a % or an amount. Tip may be 0. For a % tip, each bill has a "tip on" option: **food only (default)** or **food + tax**. Neither option includes other charges: a tip is never calculated on other charges.
4. **Rounding and order:** tax, other charges and tip are each worked out separately, in cents. Any % result is rounded half-up to the cent, so it can be 0.00 (e.g. 5% of 0.01). A "food + tax" tip uses the already-rounded tax.
5. **Grand total** = food subtotal + tax + other charges + tip.
6. **Equal split:** grand total (including other charges) ÷ number of participants. Leftover cents go 1 each to the first participants in list order, and the app shows who pays the extra cent.
7. **Itemized split:**
   - Each item has a price and 1+ ticked participants. Its cost is split evenly between them, with leftover cents going to the first ticked people.
   - Tax, other charges and tip are each split separately in proportion to each participant's food subtotal. Leftover cents are assigned by largest remainder, and ties go to the first participant in list order.
   - A participant with no items owes 0.00 (including 0.00 tax, other charges and tip).
8. **Group balances:**
   - Each group bill has one payer, and **the payer must be one of that bill's participants**. The payer list only offers ticked participants. If the payer is unticked, Calculate and Save show "The payer must be one of the people on this bill".
   - The payer is credited with the full grand total, and each participant (including the payer) is debited their share. So the payer's net change is grand total − their own share.
   - A settle-up from A to B (A pays B) credits A and debits B. A and B must be two different current members. The amount can be any valid amount (0.01–1,000,000.00, 2 decimals), **even more than A owes B**. The balances simply update, and an overpayment flips the direction of the debt.
   - Net balances across the group always sum to exactly 0.00.
9. **Invite code:**
   - Each group gets one invite code, generated automatically when the group is created. It never changes, and there is no regenerate option.
   - Any current member can view it and copy it with a Copy button.
   - Entering the code (while logged in) does one of the following:
     - **Removed member with this account:** they are **restored automatically** with their full history (the same as Restore). The log says "Omar rejoined with the invite code".
     - **New account:** they choose a name to claim from the group's **unclaimed** members, current or removed. Removed names are marked "(removed)", and claiming one restores it.
     - **Already a current member:** "You're already in this group", and nothing changes.
   - The code can't create a brand-new member. New names are added by a current member.
   - The restore limits below (50 current members, no duplicate current name) apply to rejoining with the code too.
10. **Removing, leaving and restoring members:**
   - **Settled ≠ removed.** A member with balance 0.00 is still a normal member. "Removed" means taken off the group's current member list.
   - Any member can remove another member, and any member can leave (remove themselves), but **only when that member's balance is exactly 0.00**. The one exception is the last member with an account, below.
   - **Last member with an account leaving:** when the only current member with an account presses Leave, the app warns: "You're the last member with an account. If you leave, this group and all its bills, settle-ups and history will be permanently deleted. Unsettled balances will be lost."
     - **Cancel:** nothing changes.
     - **Leave:** the whole group is permanently deleted, including its members, bills, settle-ups, activity log and invite code. Their balance doesn't need to be 0.00 first.
     - This only happens through leaving. Anyone else removing them would themselves have to be a current member with an account, so they could never be the last one.
   - Leaving or deleting never touches anyone's account or solo bills.
   - There is no separate "delete group" button.
   - Removing never changes past data. Old bills and settle-ups keep the member, shown as "Name (removed)", and every total and balance stays exactly the same.
   - A removed member can't be chosen as payer, participant or settle-up person on new bills or settle-ups. They don't appear in the balance list or the settle-up suggestions.
   - While a member is removed, any bill or settle-up that includes them is **view-only**: it can't be edited or deleted, because that would change a removed member's balance. The message is "Restore Omar to change this bill".
   - If the removed member had an account, they **lose access** to the group right away: it disappears from their group list, and its pages are refused even by typing the address directly. Their account and solo bills are untouched, and the link between their account and the member is kept.
   - The group's members page lists removed members under "Removed members", each with a **Restore** button that any current member can use. Restoring brings back the same member, with one continuous history and the "(removed)" mark gone. If they had an account, their access returns.
   - Restoring is refused with a clear message if the group already has 50 current members, or if a current member already has the same name.
   - The activity log records "X removed Omar", "Omar left", "X restored Omar" and "Omar rejoined with the invite code".
11. **Settle-up suggestions:** the fewest payments that bring every net balance to zero (greedy match of largest debtor to largest creditor), shown as "X pays Y amount".
12. **Invariant:** for every bill, the shares sum exactly to the grand total. In itemized bills, the per-person tax, other-charges and tip parts also each sum exactly to the bill's tax, other charges and tip.

## Acceptance Criteria
### Accounts (AC-A)
- [ ] Given a new username and a valid password, when I sign up, then my account is created, a one-time recovery code is shown with a "save this now" warning, and I'm logged in.
- [ ] Given a username that is already taken, when I sign up, then I see "That username is taken" and no account is created.
- [ ] Given a wrong password, when I log in, then I see "Username or password is incorrect" (without saying which one) and I stay logged out.
- [ ] Given my username + recovery code + a new password, when I reset, then I can log in with the new password, the old code stops working, and a new code is shown.
- [ ] Given I'm logged out, when I open any bill or group page, then I'm sent to login and no data is shown.
- [ ] Given I'm logged in, I can never see or change another account's solo bills, or groups I'm not a member of, even by typing the address directly.

### Solo (AC-S)
- [ ] Given items 12.50 and 7.50, tax 10%, other charges blank, tip 15% on food, when I press Calculate, then subtotal 20.00, tax 2.00, other charges 0.00, tip 3.00 and total 25.00 are shown.
- [ ] Given items 12.50 and 7.50, tax 10%, other charges 5%, tip 15% on food, when I press Calculate, then subtotal 20.00, tax 2.00, other charges 1.00, tip 3.00 and total 26.00 are shown.
- [ ] Given food 100.00, tax 10.00 (amount), other charges blank and tip 15% on food + tax, then the tip is 16.50 and the total is 126.50.
- [ ] Given food 100.00, tax 10.00 (amount), other charges 7.50 (amount) and tip 15% on food + tax, then other charges is 7.50, the tip is 16.50 (other charges are not tipped on) and the total is 134.00.
- [ ] Given food 100.00, tax 10% and other charges 10%, then other charges is 10.00 (a % of food only, not of food + tax).
- [ ] Given food 33.33 and other charges 12.5%, then other charges is 4.17 (4.16625 rounded half-up).
- [ ] Given other charges 0 or 0.00, then it is treated as "no other charges", shows 0.00, and causes no error.
- [ ] Given food 0.01, tax 0, other charges 1,000,000.00 (amount) and tip 0, then other charges is 1,000,000.00 and the total is 1,000,000.01.
- [ ] Given tip 0, then the tip shows 0.00 with no error.
- [ ] Given no items, when I press Calculate, then I see "Add at least one item" and no result.

### Equal group split (AC-E)
- [ ] Given total 100.00 with 3 participants, then the shares are 33.34 / 33.33 / 33.33, the first participant is marked as paying the extra cent, and the shares sum to 100.00.
- [ ] Given 0 participants selected, when I press Calculate, then I see "Choose who took part" and no result (no division by zero).
- [ ] Given 0.01 split between 2 participants, then the shares are 0.01 and 0.00.
- [ ] Given food 1,000,000.00, tax 0, other charges blank and a 100% tip on food, split between 50 participants, then the grand total is 2,000,000.00, each share is 40,000.00, and the shares sum to the total.
- [ ] Given food 1,000,000.00, tax 0, other charges 1,000,000.00 (amount) and tip 0, split between 3 participants, then the grand total is 2,000,000.00 and the shares are 666,666.67 / 666,666.67 / 666,666.66.
- [ ] Given food 90.00, tax 0, other charges 10% and tip 0, split between 3 participants, then other charges is 9.00, the grand total is 99.00, and each share is 33.00.
- [ ] Given food 10.00 and other charges 0.01 (amount), split between 2 participants, then the grand total is 10.01 and the shares are 5.01 and 5.00.

### Itemized group split (AC-I)
- [ ] Given Ali steak 40.00, Sara salad 10.00, tax 5.00, other charges blank and tip 10.00, then Ali's share is 52.00 and Sara's is 13.00.
- [ ] Given the same bill with other charges 2.50 (amount), then Ali pays 2.00 and Sara 0.50 of the other charges, Ali's share is 54.00, Sara's is 13.50, and they sum to the grand total of 67.50.
- [ ] Given three participants with 10.00 of food each and other charges 0.10, then their other-charges parts are 0.04 / 0.03 / 0.03 (the leftover cent goes to the first participant on a tie).
- [ ] Given a participant with no items and other charges 5.00 on the bill, then that participant's other-charges part is 0.00.
- [ ] Given nachos 12.00 ticked for Ali, Sara and Omar, then each is charged 4.00 for it, and 10.00 shared by 3 gives 3.34 / 3.33 / 3.33.
- [ ] Given an item with nobody ticked, when I press Calculate, then I see "Choose who shared this item" and no result.
- [ ] For any valid bill, the per-person totals sum exactly to the grand total.

### Groups (AC-G)
- [ ] Given I create a group with a name and a currency, then I'm its first member, I see a note that the currency can't be changed, and an invite code is generated automatically.
- [ ] Given I'm a current member, when I open the group's invite section, then I see the code and a Copy button that copies it. There is no option to regenerate or change it.
- [ ] Given a group of 10 members, when I add a bill with 5 participants paid by one of them, then only those 5 are charged and the other 5 balances don't change.
- [ ] Given a bill's participants are Ali and Sara, then the payer list offers only Ali and Sara.
- [ ] Given Omar is chosen as payer and then unticked as a participant, when I press Calculate or Save, then I see "The payer must be one of the people on this bill" and nothing is saved.
- [ ] Given Sara owes Ali 13.00, when I record "Sara paid Ali 20.00", then Sara's balance is +7.00, Ali's is −7.00, and the suggestion reads "Ali pays Sara 7.00".
- [ ] Given a settle-up from a member to the same member, or with an amount outside 0.01–1,000,000.00, then a clear message is shown and nothing is saved.
- [ ] Given Ali paid 65.00 and Ali 52.00 / Sara 13.00 are the shares, then Ali's net balance is +13.00, Sara's is −13.00, and the suggestion reads "Sara pays Ali 13.00".
- [ ] Given net balances across the group, they always sum to exactly 0.00.
- [ ] Given I record "Sara paid Ali 13.00", then both balances become 0.00 and the suggestion disappears.
- [ ] Given I add a name-only member "Omar", then Omar can be a participant (and the payer of a bill he takes part in) right away.
- [ ] Given Omar signs up and enters the group's invite code, when he chooses "I'm Omar", then his account is linked to that member and he sees the full group history.
- [ ] Given a member already claimed by an account, another account can't claim it, and the same account can't claim two members in one group.
- [ ] Given a wrong invite code, then I see "That invite code isn't valid" and join nothing.
- [ ] Given a valid invite code and a new account, when I enter it, then I can choose from all unclaimed members. Removed ones are marked "(removed)", and already-claimed members aren't offered. There's no option to add myself as a new name.
- [ ] Given Omar has an account and was removed, when he enters the invite code, then he's restored automatically with his full history and access, and the log records "Omar rejoined with the invite code".
- [ ] Given I'm already a current member, when I enter the group's invite code, then I see "You're already in this group" and nothing changes.
- [ ] Given a new account claims a removed, unclaimed name, then that member is restored and linked to the account.
- [ ] Given the group has 50 current members, or a current member is already named Omar, when Omar enters the invite code, then a clear message is shown and he stays removed.
- [ ] Given any member edits or deletes a bill or settle-up, then the balances update, and the activity log shows who did it, when, and what changed.
- [ ] Given deleting a bill, then a confirmation is asked first. Cancel keeps the bill.
- [ ] Given a member whose balance isn't 0.00, when anyone tries to remove them, then I see "Settle this member's balance before removing them" and nothing changes.
- [ ] Given my own balance isn't 0.00 and another current member has an account, when I try to leave, then I see "Settle your balance before leaving" and I stay in the group.
- [ ] Given Omar's balance is 0.00, when any member removes him (or he leaves), then he moves to "Removed members", and the activity log records it ("X removed Omar" or "Omar left").
- [ ] Given Omar is removed, when I open "Pizza night" (which he paid for), then it shows "Omar (removed)" as payer and participant, and the bill's totals and all balances are exactly as before.
- [ ] Given Omar is removed, when I add a new bill or settle-up, then Omar isn't offered as payer, participant or settle-up person, and he isn't in the balance list or the suggestions.
- [ ] Given Omar is removed, when I try to edit or delete a bill or settle-up that includes him, then I see "Restore Omar to change this bill" and nothing changes.
- [ ] Given Omar has an account and is removed, then the group disappears from his group list, and opening its address shows that he no longer has access. His solo bills are unchanged.
- [ ] Given Omar is removed, when any member presses Restore, then he's a current member again with his full history and no "(removed)" mark. If he had an account, his access returns, and the log records "X restored Omar".
- [ ] Given the group has 50 current members, or a current member is already named Omar, when anyone tries to restore Omar, then a clear message is shown and he stays removed.
- [ ] Given I'm the last current member with an account, when I press Leave, then I see the warning that the group and all its bills, settle-ups and history will be permanently deleted and that unsettled balances will be lost.
- [ ] Given that warning, when I press Cancel, then nothing changes.
- [ ] Given that warning, when I press Leave (whatever my balance), then the group is permanently deleted. It disappears for everyone, its address shows "This group no longer exists", and its invite code becomes invalid.
- [ ] Given a group was deleted, then my account, my solo bills and my other groups are unchanged.
- [ ] Given a group with 50 current members, when I add another, then I see "A group can have at most 50 members".

### Input validation & recovery (all modes)
- [ ] Given a money field containing "abc", "-5", "1.234", "1000000.01" or a blank, then a message next to the field explains the rule and no result is shown.
- [ ] Given tax or tip % outside 0–100, then a clear message is shown and no result.
- [ ] Given tip 12.5% on food 20.00, then the tip is 2.50. Given tax 8.25% on food 20.00, then the tax is 1.65.
- [ ] Given a tax or tip % with more than 2 decimal places (e.g. 12.345), then a clear message is shown and no result.
- [ ] Given other charges as an amount of "abc", "-1", "0.001" or "1000000.01", then the message "Other charges must be between 0.01 and 1,000,000.00, or left empty" appears next to the field and no result is shown.
- [ ] Given other charges as a % of "abc", "-5", "0.001" or "100.01", then the message "Other charges must be between 0.01% and 100%, or left empty" appears next to the field and no result is shown.
- [ ] Given I switch other charges between % and amount after a result is showing, then the old result is hidden until I press Calculate again.
- [ ] Given an error is showing, when I fix the field and press Calculate, then the error clears and the correct result appears, with no reload needed.
- [ ] Given a result is showing, when I change any input, then the old result is hidden until I press Calculate again.
- [ ] The app never shows NaN, Infinity, "undefined" or a blank/crashed screen, and the server rejects invalid data even when it's sent directly, bypassing the page.
- [ ] Given the server can't be reached, when I save, then I see "Couldn't save — check your connection" and my inputs are kept.

### History (AC-H)
- [ ] Given I save a solo bill, then it appears at the top of my history with name, date, currency and total. The name is optional and defaults to "Bill – date".
- [ ] Given a saved solo bill, I can open it, edit it (with the same validation and recalculation as a new bill, and the currency locked) and delete it after a confirmation.
- [ ] Given a saved bill (solo or group) with other charges, when I reopen it, then the other-charges value and its % / amount setting are shown exactly as saved, and editing them recalculates the total (and group balances).
- [ ] Given the server restarts, then all bills, groups and balances are still there.

### Tech & setup (AC-T)
- [ ] With Node.js LTS installed, a fresh clone plus the README steps (install, start, open URL) gives a working app, and I can sign up locally. No outside service, key or account is needed.
- [ ] The same build runs on a server, configured only through settings the app owns (port, database file location, session secret).
- [ ] Calculation and validation tests plus browser tests (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) pass with one command.

### Product docs (AC-D)
- [ ] docs/ follows the saved format rules: role/job/story templates, story → job → role links, Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, and Implemented / Not implemented status.
- [ ] Every story marked Implemented passes its acceptance criteria in the running app.

## Roles (for docs)
- **Solo diner:** eats or shops alone and wants an accurate personal total and a private record of spending. Must never see other people's bills, or have their solo bills seen by anyone else.
- **Group member:** belongs to one or more friend groups, all with equal rights. Can add, edit or delete group bills and settle-ups, add name-only friends, view and copy the invite code, see balances, remove or restore members, and leave the group. Must never see groups they aren't in (including groups they were removed from), remove or leave while a balance isn't 0.00 (unless they're the last member with an account leaving, which deletes the group after a warning), record a bill whose payer isn't a participant, change a bill that includes a removed member, or change a group's currency.
- Friends who never sign up exist only as **name-only members**. They are data, not a role.

## Assumptions Exposed & Resolved
| Assumption | Challenge | Resolution |
|------------|-----------|------------|
| Solo use is one-off | R1 | Keep a history |
| Tax/tip split equally | R2 | Proportional to food |
| History in the browser | R3 | Server-side database |
| Need three modes | R4 (contrarian) | Keep three modes |
| Rounding just works | R5 | Cent-exact, extra cents shown |
| One owner per item | R6 (simplifier) | Shared items allowed |
| One way to enter tax/tip | R7 | % or amount for each |
| No limits needed | R8 | Explicit limits; currency per group/bill, locked |
| Saved bills fixed | R9 | View, edit, delete |
| Stack open | R10 | TypeScript everywhere |
| Live results | R11 | Calculate button; stale results hidden |
| Tip base fixed | R12 | Per-bill option, food only by default |
| Groups are one-off splits | R13 (ontologist) | Lasting groups, equal members, subset bills |
| "No cloud" means local only | R14 | No third-party services; deployable; real accounts |
| Bills split once and forgotten | R15 | Payer + running balances + settle-up |
| Everyone must have an account | R16 | Name-only members, claimable by invite code |
| Need an admin | R17 | Everyone equal + activity log |
| Email reset needed | R18 | One-time recovery code |
| Several payers needed | R19 | One payer + simplified settle-up |
| Payer can be anyone in the group | Open-assumption review | The payer must be a participant of the bill |
| Settle-ups capped at what's owed | Open-assumption review | Any valid amount; overpayment flips the debt |
| "Removed" = deleted | Open-assumption review | Removed ≠ settled. Removal only at balance 0.00; kept on old bills as "(removed)"; those bills are view-only; can be restored, or rejoin with the invite code; account loses access; members can leave; the last member with an account leaving deletes the group after a warning |
| Invite codes can be regenerated | Open-assumption review | Auto-generated once and never changes; any member can view and copy |
| A bill is only items, tax and tip | Post-R19 change by user | Optional "Other charges" field: % of food or amount 0.01–1,000,000.00; not taxed or tipped; split in proportion to food in itemized bills |

## Technical Context
- **Language:** TypeScript (frontend and backend), with a shared pure calculation module that works in integer cents and is used by both the page and the server.
- **Frontend:** React built with Vite. **Backend:** Node.js LTS + Express, serving the API and the built frontend from one process (easy to deploy).
- **Database:** SQLite file; prefer Node's built-in `node:sqlite` so no native build step is needed.
- **Auth:** password hashing with Node's built-in `crypto.scrypt`, server-side sessions in an httpOnly, SameSite cookie, and login rate limiting done in-app.
- **Tests:** Vitest (calculation, validation and API) and Playwright (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit).
- **Layout:** `src/` (client, server, shared), `tests/`, `docs/`, `transcripts/`, README.

## Ontology (Key Entities)
| Entity | Type | Fields | Relationships |
|--------|------|--------|---------------|
| Account | core | username, passwordHash, recoveryCodeHash | owns SoloBills; claims Members |
| Group | core | name, currency, inviteCode (auto-generated, never changes) | has Members, GroupBills, SettleUps, ActivityEntries |
| Member | core | displayName, accountId? (null = name-only), status (current / removed) | belongs to Group; participant in GroupBills; payer only of bills they take part in |
| SoloBill | core | name, currency, items, tax, otherCharges, tip, tipBase | belongs to Account |
| GroupBill | core | name, splitMode (equal/itemized), payer, participants, items, tax, otherCharges, tip, tipBase | belongs to Group |
| Item | core | name, priceCents, sharers | belongs to a bill |
| Share | derived | memberId, food/tax/otherCharges/tip/total cents, extraCent | computed per participant |
| SettleUp | core | from, to, amountCents, date | belongs to Group |
| Balance | derived | memberId, netCents | computed from GroupBills + SettleUps |
| SuggestedPayment | derived | from, to, amountCents | computed from Balances |
| ActivityEntry | supporting | who, when, action, before/after | belongs to Group |
| Currency, Tax, OtherCharges, Tip | supporting | symbol; mode (% / amount) + value (OtherCharges: none when blank/0) | on Group/bills |

## Ontology Convergence
| Round | Entity Count | New | Stable | Stability Ratio |
|-------|-------------|-----|--------|----------------|
| 1 | 6 | 6 | - | - |
| 5 | 10 | 1 | 9 | 90% |
| 10 | 11 | 0 | 11 | 100% |
| 13 | 12 | 1 (Group) | 10 + 1 renamed (Person→Member) | 83% → reframed |
| 14 | 13 | 1 (Account) | 12 | 85% |
| 15 | 15 | 2 (SettleUp, Balance) | 13 | 87% |
| 17 | 16 | 1 (ActivityEntry) | 15 | 94% |
| 19 | 17 | 1 (SuggestedPayment) | 16 | 94% |

## Open Assumptions
None. All earlier assumptions have been confirmed by the user and moved into the rules above.

## Interview Transcript
<details>
<summary>Q&A summary (19 rounds)</summary>

- **R0** 5 components confirmed (Groups and Accounts were added later).
- **R1** Solo: **keep history** · **R2** Tax/tip: **proportional** · **R3** Storage: **server + database**
- **R4** (contrarian) **Three separate modes** · **R5** Rounding: **cent-exact** · **R6** (simplifier) **Shared items**
- **R7** Tax/tip: **% or amount** · **R8** Limits: accepted; currency symbol per group, locked, with a note · **R9** History: **view, edit, delete**
- **R10** Stack: **TypeScript everywhere** (v1 spec at 15.1%; user chose to keep refining)
- **R11** **Calculate button** · **R12** Tip base: **user chooses per bill**
- **R13** Roles: Solo diner + equal Group members; lasting groups; bills for a subset of members (ambiguity rose to 28.5%)
- **R14** **Real accounts**; "no cloud" = no third-party services; deployable to a server (35%)
- **R15** **Payer + running balances** (30.4%) · **R16** **Name-only members + invite code to claim** (25.9%)
- **R17** **Everyone equal + activity log** (23%) · **R18** **Recovery code** (19.8%) · **R19** **One payer + simplified settle-up** (17.6%)
- **Change (v2.1)** User added an **Other charges** field. Follow-up answers: a % is of the **food subtotal**; it's **optional** (blank/0 = none; amount 0.01–1,000,000.00, % 0.01–100); it's **never tipped on**; and in itemized bills it's split **in proportion to food**.
- **Change (v2.2)** Open assumptions settled:
  - **Payer must be a participant.**
  - **Settle-ups can be any valid amount**, including more than is owed.
  - **Invite code** is generated once and never changes; any member can view and copy it.
  - **Removed members** (removal only at balance 0.00) stay on old bills marked "(removed)", can be **restored** by any member, **lose access** if they have an account, and members can **leave** themselves at balance 0.00.
- **Change (v2.3)**:
  - The last member with an account **can** leave. After a warning, the group is **permanently deleted**, and no 0.00 balance is needed.
  - The invite code also **restores removed members** who enter it, and lets new accounts claim removed, unclaimed names. It still can't create brand-new members.
  - User confirmed: claiming a removed, unclaimed name restores it, and there's no separate "delete group" button.
  - User confirmed: no quick split without a group, and tax and tip % allow up to 2 decimal places. No open assumptions remain.
</details>
