1	# Deep Interview Spec: Bill Splitting Calculator (v2)
2	
3	## Metadata
4	- Interview ID: b7e2c1a4-5d3f-4e8a-9c21-bill-splitter-01
5	- Rounds: 19 (plus Round 0 topology check)
6	- Final Ambiguity Score: 17.6%
7	- Type: greenfield
8	- Generated: 2026-10-21 (v2 replaces the v1 spec written after Round 10; v2.1 adds the Other charges field; v2.2 settles payer, settle-up, invite code and member-removal rules; v2.3 adds group deletion by the last account holder and rejoining with the invite code)
9	- Threshold: 0.2
10	- Threshold Source: default
11	- Initial Context Summarized: no
12	- Status: PASSED — pending approval
13	
14	## Clarity Breakdown
15	| Dimension | Score | Weight | Weighted |
16	|-----------|-------|--------|----------|
17	| Goal Clarity | 0.86 | 0.40 | 0.344 |
18	| Constraint Clarity | 0.84 | 0.30 | 0.252 |
19	| Success Criteria | 0.76 | 0.30 | 0.228 |
20	| **Total Clarity** | | | **0.824** |
21	| **Ambiguity** | | | **0.176** |
22	
23	## Topology
24	| Component | Status | Description | Coverage |
25	|-----------|--------|-------------|----------|
26	| Solo bill | active | A logged-in person totals their own bill (items, tax, other charges, tip) and keeps a private history | AC-S, AC-H |
27	| Equal group split | active | A group bill (items, tax, other charges, tip) split evenly between the members who took part, cent-exact | AC-E |
28	| Itemized group split | active | Each participant pays for what they had (items can be shared) plus proportional tax, other charges and tip | AC-I |
29	| Groups (added R13) | active | Lasting friend groups: name-only or claimed members, payer, running balances, settle-ups, activity log | AC-G |
30	| Accounts (added R14) | active | In-app username/password accounts with a recovery code; no outside services | AC-A |
31	| Tech choices and setup | active | TypeScript, React, Node.js/Express, SQLite; runs locally from the README and deploys to any server | AC-T |
32	| Product docs | active | Roles, jobs and stories in the saved format, kept in line with the app | AC-D |
33	
34	## Goal
35	A self-contained web app for splitting and tracking bills:
36	- **Solo diners** total their own bills (items, tax, other charges and tip) and keep a private history.
37	- **Friends** form lasting groups. Any member can record a group bill: who paid, who took part, and whether it's split equally or by items. The app keeps exact running balances, shows the fewest payments needed to settle up, and records settle-ups.
38	
39	All money math is exact to the cent, and every invalid input gives a clear message, never a crash or a wrong result.
40	
41	## Constraints
42	- **Browsers:** current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari.
43	- **No third-party services:** the app must not depend on any external cloud or paid service (no hosted auth, hosted database, email/SMS or payment APIs). It **can** be deployed to a server. Reviewers must be able to run it locally from the README with only free software (Node.js LTS).
44	- **Accounts:** built into the app. Username + password, with passwords hashed. Sessions use secure cookies. No email anywhere.
45	- **Storage:** SQLite database file managed by the app's own server.
46	- **Modes:** Solo (personal), Group bill with Equal split, and Group bill with Itemized split. These are separate screens and rules (Round 4).
47	- **Number limits:**
48	  - Money: 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places. No negatives, letters, blanks or extra decimals.
49	  - Group size: 1–50 **current** members. A group starts with just its creator, and removed members don't count toward the 50.
50	  - Tax and tip %: 0–100, at most 2 decimal places (e.g. 12.5 or 8.25). Tax and tip amounts: 0.00–1,000,000.00.
51	  - Other charges (optional): blank, 0 or 0.00 means "no other charges". Otherwise:
52	    - as an amount: 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places
53	    - as a %: 0.01–100, at most 2 decimal places
54	    - negatives, letters and extra decimals are rejected.
55	- **Bill fields:** every bill (solo and both group modes) has the same four money parts: items, tax, **other charges** and tip. Other charges is a single field per bill, always labelled "Other charges" (for service, delivery or table fees and similar), with a % / amount switch like tax and tip.
56	- **Currency:** a display symbol only, picked from a fixed list (e.g. $, €, £, ¥, ₹, Rs), with no conversion.
57	  - Each **group** has one currency, chosen at creation and never changeable. A note says so when you choose it.
58	  - Each **solo bill** has its own currency, locked when the bill is first saved.
59	- **Math:** integer cents only, never floating-point money.
60	- **Results:** totals appear when the user presses **Calculate**. Changing any input hides the old result until Calculate is pressed again.
61	
62	## Non-Goals
63	- Currency conversion; multiple currencies in one group.
64	- Email or SMS (invites, password resets, notifications).
65	- Real payment processing (settle-ups are records only).
66	- Receipt scanning, native mobile apps, real-time push updates.
67	- Multiple payers on one bill (Round 19).
68	- Regenerating or changing a group's invite code.
69	- A quick split without a group: splitting a bill between people always happens inside a group, even for a one-off outing.
70	- Permanently deleting a member, or erasing their part of past bills.
71	- More than one other-charges line per bill, or custom labels for it.
72	- Tax on other charges, or tip on other charges.
73	
74	## Calculation Rules
75	1. **Tax:** a % (of the food subtotal) or an amount. Tax is never charged on other charges or tip.
76	2. **Other charges:** optional; a % or an amount. A % is a percentage of the **food subtotal only** (the same base as tax), never of tax or tip. Blank or 0 means 0.00 other charges, and the results still show an "Other charges 0.00" line.
77	3. **Tip:** a % or an amount. Tip may be 0. For a % tip, each bill has a "tip on" option: **food only (default)** or **food + tax**. Neither option includes other charges: a tip is never calculated on other charges.
78	4. **Rounding and order:** tax, other charges and tip are each worked out separately, in cents. Any % result is rounded half-up to the cent, so it can be 0.00 (e.g. 5% of 0.01). A "food + tax" tip uses the already-rounded tax.
79	5. **Grand total** = food subtotal + tax + other charges + tip.
80	6. **Equal split:** grand total (including other charges) ÷ number of participants. Leftover cents go 1 each to the first participants in list order, and the app shows who pays the extra cent.
81	7. **Itemized split:**
82	   - Each item has a price and 1+ ticked participants. Its cost is split evenly between them, with leftover cents going to the first ticked people.
83	   - Tax, other charges and tip are each split separately in proportion to each participant's food subtotal. Leftover cents are assigned by largest remainder, and ties go to the first participant in list order.
84	   - A participant with no items owes 0.00 (including 0.00 tax, other charges and tip).
85	8. **Group balances:**
86	   - Each group bill has one payer, and **the payer must be one of that bill's participants**. The payer list only offers ticked participants. If the payer is unticked, Calculate and Save show "The payer must be one of the people on this bill".
87	   - The payer is credited with the full grand total, and each participant (including the payer) is debited their share. So the payer's net change is grand total − their own share.
88	   - A settle-up from A to B (A pays B) credits A and debits B. A and B must be two different current members. The amount can be any valid amount (0.01–1,000,000.00, 2 decimals), **even more than A owes B**. The balances simply update, and an overpayment flips the direction of the debt.
89	   - Net balances across the group always sum to exactly 0.00.
90	9. **Invite code:**
91	   - Each group gets one invite code, generated automatically when the group is created. It never changes, and there is no regenerate option.
92	   - Any current member can view it and copy it with a Copy button.
93	   - Entering the code (while logged in) does one of the following:
94	     - **Removed member with this account:** they are **restored automatically** with their full history (the same as Restore). The log says "Omar rejoined with the invite code".
95	     - **New account:** they choose a name to claim from the group's **unclaimed** members, current or removed. Removed names are marked "(removed)", and claiming one restores it.
96	     - **Already a current member:** "You're already in this group", and nothing changes.
97	   - The code can't create a brand-new member. New names are added by a current member.
98	   - The restore limits below (50 current members, no duplicate current name) apply to rejoining with the code too.
99	10. **Removing, leaving and restoring members:**
100	   - **Settled ≠ removed.** A member with balance 0.00 is still a normal member. "Removed" means taken off the group's current member list.
101	   - Any member can remove another member, and any member can leave (remove themselves), but **only when that member's balance is exactly 0.00**. The one exception is the last member with an account, below.
102	   - **Last member with an account leaving:** when the only current member with an account presses Leave, the app warns: "You're the last member with an account. If you leave, this group and all its bills, settle-ups and history will be permanently deleted. Unsettled balances will be lost."
103	     - **Cancel:** nothing changes.
104	     - **Leave:** the whole group is permanently deleted, including its members, bills, settle-ups, activity log and invite code. Their balance doesn't need to be 0.00 first.
105	     - This only happens through leaving. Anyone else removing them would themselves have to be a current member with an account, so they could never be the last one.
106	   - Leaving or deleting never touches anyone's account or solo bills.
107	   - There is no separate "delete group" button.
108	   - Removing never changes past data. Old bills and settle-ups keep the member, shown as "Name (removed)", and every total and balance stays exactly the same.
109	   - A removed member can't be chosen as payer, participant or settle-up person on new bills or settle-ups. They don't appear in the balance list or the settle-up suggestions.
110	   - While a member is removed, any bill or settle-up that includes them is **view-only**: it can't be edited or deleted, because that would change a removed member's balance. The message is "Restore Omar to change this bill".
111	   - If the removed member had an account, they **lose access** to the group right away: it disappears from their group list, and its pages are refused even by typing the address directly. Their account and solo bills are untouched, and the link between their account and the member is kept.
112	   - The group's members page lists removed members under "Removed members", each with a **Restore** button that any current member can use. Restoring brings back the same member, with one continuous history and the "(removed)" mark gone. If they had an account, their access returns.
113	   - Restoring is refused with a clear message if the group already has 50 current members, or if a current member already has the same name.
114	   - The activity log records "X removed Omar", "Omar left", "X restored Omar" and "Omar rejoined with the invite code".
115	11. **Settle-up suggestions:** the fewest payments that bring every net balance to zero (greedy match of largest debtor to largest creditor), shown as "X pays Y amount".
116	12. **Invariant:** for every bill, the shares sum exactly to the grand total. In itemized bills, the per-person tax, other-charges and tip parts also each sum exactly to the bill's tax, other charges and tip.
117	
118	## Acceptance Criteria
119	### Accounts (AC-A)
120	- [ ] Given a new username and a valid password, when I sign up, then my account is created, a one-time recovery code is shown with a "save this now" warning, and I'm logged in.
121	- [ ] Given a username that is already taken, when I sign up, then I see "That username is taken" and no account is created.
122	- [ ] Given a wrong password, when I log in, then I see "Username or password is incorrect" (without saying which one) and I stay logged out.

# App Roles

Who uses the Bill Splitting Calculator. Each role is a different kind of person with different needs. Jobs are in [jobs-to-be-done.md](jobs-to-be-done.md), and stories are in [user-stories.md](user-stories.md).

## Solo diner

A **Solo diner** is someone who eats out, orders in or shops on their own and pays their own bill. They want to know the exact amount to pay, including tax, any other charges (such as a service, delivery or table fee) and tip, and they want a private record of what they've spent.

They can:
- create an account with a username and password, receive a one-time recovery code, log in, and reset a forgotten password with that code
- enter a bill's items, tax, other charges and tip, each of tax, other charges and tip as a % or an amount, and choose whether a % tip is on the food only or on the food + tax
- pick the bill's currency symbol, press Calculate and see the subtotal, tax, other charges, tip and total, exact to the cent
- save the bill to their personal history, then reopen, edit or delete saved bills

They must never:
- see another person's solo bills, or have their own solo bills seen or changed by anyone else, even by typing a page address directly
- change a solo bill's currency once that bill has been saved
- be shown a wrong, stale or broken result (such as NaN, Infinity or "undefined") for any input

## Group member

A **Group member** belongs to one or more lasting groups of friends who share costs again and again: meals, trips, groceries. Every member has equal rights; there is no admin or organizer. A bill may involve the whole group or only the members who took part, and one person usually pays the bill for everyone. They want to know, at any time, who owes whom across all the group's bills, and the fewest payments needed to settle up.

They can:
- create a group with a name and a currency, and add friends to it by name, even friends who never create an account
- view the group's invite code and copy it, and use an invite code to join a group by claiming their name, or to rejoin a group they were removed from
- record a group bill: choose who took part, who paid (one of the people who took part) and whether to split it equally or by items, with shared items split between the people who had them
- see every member's running balance and the suggested payments to settle up, and record settle-ups (repayments) of any valid amount
- add, edit or delete any group bill or settle-up, and see every change in the group's activity log
- remove a member whose balance is 0.00, leave the group when their own balance is 0.00, and restore removed members
- as the last member with an account, leave after a warning, which permanently deletes the group

They must never:
- see or open a group they don't belong to, including a group they've been removed from
- remove another member, or leave themselves, while that member's balance isn't 0.00. The one exception is the last member with an account leaving, which deletes the group after a warning.
- record a bill whose payer isn't one of the people who took part in it
- edit or delete a bill or settle-up that includes a removed member, until that member is restored
- change the group's currency after the group is created
- create a brand-new member by entering an invite code; only current members add new names

## Host

A **Host** is someone who installs and runs their own copy of the app. This is either a reviewer checking the project on their own computer, or someone running it on a server so their friends can use it. They don't need to know how the app works inside, but they need it to start reliably by following the README, with nothing to buy or sign up for.

They can:
- install it with only free software (Node.js LTS) and start it by following the README
- run it on a server, configured only through settings the app owns (port, database file location, session secret)
- run all of the app's automated tests with one command

They must never:
- need a paid account, an API key or any third-party cloud or paid service to install, run, test or deploy the app

## How the roles differ

| Need | Solo diner | Group member | Host |
|---|---|---|---|
| Main question | "What do I owe for this bill?" | "Who owes whom across all our bills?" | "Does it run and work as promised?" |
| Who sees the data | Only them | Only the group's current members | Doesn't use bill data |
| Splitting | None, one person pays everything | Equal or by items, among the people who took part | — |
| Payer and balances | Not needed | One payer per bill, running balances, settle-ups | — |
| Changing records | Their own bills only | Any group bill or settle-up, with every change logged | — |
| Account needed | Yes | Yes, to log in; friends without accounts appear as name-only members | No app account needed to install or run |

## Notes

- **One person can hold several roles.** The same account can keep solo bills (Solo diner) and belong to groups (Group member).

## Solo diner

A **Solo diner** is someone who eats out, orders in or shops on their own and pays their own bill. They want to know the exact amount to pay, including tax, any other charges (such as a service, delivery or table fee) and tip, and they want a private record of what they've spent.

They can:
- create an account with a username and password, receive a one-time recovery code, log in, and reset a forgotten password with that code
- enter a bill's items, tax, other charges and tip, each of tax, other charges and tip as a % or an amount, and choose whether a % tip is on the food only or on the food + tax
- pick the bill's currency symbol, press Calculate and see the subtotal, tax, other charges, tip and total, exact to the cent
- save the bill to their personal history, then reopen, edit or delete saved bills

They must never:
- see another person's solo bills, or have their own solo bills seen or changed by anyone else, even by typing a page address directly
- change a solo bill's currency once that bill has been saved
- be shown a wrong, stale or broken result (such as NaN, Infinity or "undefined") for any input

## Group member

A **Group member** belongs to one or more lasting groups of friends who share costs again and again: meals, trips, groceries. Every member has equal rights; there is no admin or organizer. A bill may involve the whole group or only the members who took part, and one person usually pays the bill for everyone. They want to know, at any time, who owes whom across all the group's bills, and the fewest payments needed to settle up.

- create a group with a name and a currency, and add friends to it by name, even friends who never create an account
- view the group's invite code and copy it, and use an invite code to join a group by claiming their name, or to rejoin a group they were removed from
- record a group bill: choose who took part, who paid (one of the people who took part) and whether to split it equally or by items, with shared items split between the people who had them
- see every member's running balance and the suggested payments to settle up, and record settle-ups (repayments) of any valid amount
- add, edit or delete any group bill or settle-up, and see every change in the group's activity log
- remove a member whose balance is 0.00, leave the group when their own balance is 0.00, and restore removed members
- as the last member with an account, leave after a warning, which permanently deletes the group

- see or open a group they don't belong to, including a group they've been removed from
- remove another member, or leave themselves, while that member's balance isn't 0.00. The one exception is the last member with an account leaving, which deletes the group after a warning.
- record a bill whose payer isn't one of the people who took part in it

- change the group's currency after the group is created

input.content:
# Jobs to Be Done

Why people use the Bill Splitting Calculator. Each job is something the person needs to get done whether or not this app exists, so no job mentions the app, its screens or its buttons. Each job names the role it belongs to (see [app-roles.md](app-roles.md)), and every story in [user-stories.md](user-stories.md) names the job it serves.

## Solo diner

**J1. Know exactly what I owe**
When I've finished a meal or a purchase on my own and the bill adds tax, extra fees and a tip, I want to know the exact amount to pay, to the cent, so I can pay the right amount without doing the maths in my head.
- Role: Solo diner

**J2. Keep a record of my own spending**
When I look back at what I've spent on meals and purchases, I want an accurate record of each past bill that I can correct or remove, so I can keep track of my spending and trust the numbers.
- Role: Solo diner

## Group member

**J3. Share a bill evenly**
When a group of us shares one bill and we agree to split it evenly, I want each person's share worked out so that the shares add up to exactly the bill, so I can make sure nobody pays a cent too much or too little.
- Role: Group member

**J4. Pay for what each person had**
When a group of us orders different things, including dishes some of us share, I want each person to pay for what they had plus a fair part of the tax, fees and tip, so I can make the split fair to people who ordered less.
- Role: Group member

**J5. Charge only the people who were there**
When one friend pays for an outing that only some of our friend group joined, I want to note who paid and who took part, so I can make sure only the people who were there owe a share and the person who paid gets it back.
- Role: Group member

**J6. Know who owes whom overall**
When my friends and I share costs again and again over weeks or months, I want to know at any moment what each person owes or is owed in total, and the fewest payments that would square everyone up, so I can settle debts without long lists of back-and-forth payments.
- Role: Group member

**J7. Count repayments**
When one friend pays another back, I want that repayment taken off what they owed, even if they pay back more than they owed, so I can keep everyone's running totals correct.
- Role: Group member

**J8. Include friends who don't keep records**
When some friends in our circle don't keep their own records of shared costs, I want to include them in our shared costs from the start and let them take over their own part whenever they choose to, so I can keep everyone's history complete.
- Role: Group member

**J9. See who changed what**
When anyone in our group adds, changes or removes a shared cost or a repayment, I want to see who did it, when, and what changed, so I can trust the totals and sort out disagreements.
- Role: Group member

**J10. Keep history right when people leave or come back**
When someone leaves our circle of friends, or comes back later, I want their past share to stay exactly as it was and their access to our shared records to end or return with them, so I can keep our history correct and keep it private to the people currently in the group.
- Role: Group member

**J11. Close out a group for good**
When I'm the last person still keeping a group's shared records and we're finished with them, I want to close them out completely, so I can leave nothing behind.
- Role: Group member

## Solo diner and Group member

**J12. Keep my money records private**
When I keep records of what I've spent, paid or am owed, I want only me, or only the friends a record concerns, to be able to see or change them, so I can trust that nobody else reads or alters my financial details.
- Roles: Solo diner, Group member

**J13. Get back in without help**
When I forget the secret I use to protect my records, I want a way to regain access that doesn't depend on anyone else, so I can make sure I never lose my history.
- Roles: Solo diner, Group member

**J14. Catch mistakes before relying on a figure**
When I'm working out money amounts and I make a typing mistake or enter something impossible, I want the mistake caught and clearly explained before I rely on the result, so I can never pay or charge someone the wrong amount.
- Roles: Solo diner, Group member

**J15. See amounts in my own currency**
When I pay in a particular currency, I want amounts shown with that currency's symbol and kept in one currency throughout, so I can read every figure without confusion.
- Roles: Solo diner, Group member

**J16. Use the browser I already have**
When I need to work out or check a bill, I want to do it in whichever common, up-to-date web browser I already use, so I can avoid installing or buying anything extra.
- Roles: Solo diner, Group member

## Host

**J17. Try it on my own computer for free**
When I want to try out or review a piece of software, I want to install and run my own copy on my computer with only free tools and no outside accounts or services, so I can evaluate it without paying or signing up for anything.
- Role: Host

**J18. Run it on my own server**
When I want my friends to use a tool for real, I want to run it on a server I control, without depending on any third-party company's services, so I can keep it running and keep our data with us.
- Role: Host

**J19. Get proof that it works**
When I evaluate a piece of software, I want quick, repeatable proof that it behaves as described in the common web browsers, so I can trust its claims without checking everything by hand.
- Role: Host

When someone leaves our circle of friends, or comes back later, I want their past share to stay exactly as it was and their access to our shared records to end or return with them, so I can keep our history correct and keep it private to the people currently in the group.
- Role: Group member

**J11. Close out a group for good**
When I'm the last person still keeping a group's shared records and we're finished with them, I want to close them out completely, so I can leave nothing behind.
- Role: Group member

## Solo diner and Group member

**J12. Keep my money records private**
When I keep records of what I've spent, paid or am owed, I want only me, or only the friends a record concerns, to be able to see or change them, so I can trust that nobody else reads or alters my financial details.
- Roles: Solo diner, Group member

**J13. Get back in without help**
When I forget the secret I use to protect my records, I want a way to regain access that doesn't depend on anyone else, so I can make sure I never lose my history.
- Roles: Solo diner, Group member

When I'm working out money amounts and I make a typing mistake or enter something impossible, I want the mistake caught and clearly explained before I rely on the result, so I can never pay or charge someone the wrong amount.

**J15. See amounts in my own currency**
When I pay in a particular currency, I want amounts shown with that currency's symbol and kept in one currency throughout, so I can read every figure without confusion.
- Roles: Solo diner, Group member

**J16. Use the browser I already have**
When I need to work out or check a bill, I want to do it in whichever common, up-to-date web browser I already use, so I can avoid installing or buying anything extra.
- Roles: Solo diner, Group member

## Host

**J17. Try it on my own computer for free**
When I want to try out or review a piece of software, I want to install and run my own copy on my computer with only free tools and no outside accounts or services, so I can evaluate it without paying or signing up for anything.
- Role: Host

**J18. Run it on my own server**
When I want my friends to use a tool for real, I want to run it on a server I control, without depending on any third-party company's services, so I can keep it running and keep our data with us.
- Role: Host

**J19. Get proof that it works**
When I evaluate a piece of software, I want quick, repeatable proof that it behaves as described in the common web browsers, so I can trust its claims without checking everything by hand.
- Role: Host

# User Stories

How the Bill Splitting Calculator helps each role get their jobs done. Every story names its role (from [app-roles.md](app-roles.md)) and the job it serves (from [jobs-to-be-done.md](jobs-to-be-done.md)), and has testable acceptance criteria and a status.

## How to read this file

- **Template:** "As a [role], I want [capability], so that [benefit]."
- **Acceptance criteria:** written as "Given [starting state], when [action], then [observable result]". They cover:
  - the normal case
  - invalid input
  - boundary values
  - very large and very small numbers
  - what happens when the user carries on after a result or an error
- **Status:** **Implemented** means the running app does exactly what every criterion says today. **Not implemented** means it doesn't yet. No app code exists yet, so every story is currently **Not implemented**.
- **Money format:** amounts are shown with 2 decimals and the bill's or group's currency symbol. The examples below leave out the symbol.

## Shared rules used by many stories

These rules come from the spec and apply wherever a story mentions them.

- **Money fields** (item prices, settle-up amounts): 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places. No negatives, letters, blanks or extra decimals.
- **Tax and tip:** each can be a **%** (0–100, at most 2 decimal places, e.g. 12.5 or 8.25) or an **amount** (0.00–1,000,000.00). Tip may be 0.
- **Other charges** (optional, one field per bill, always labelled "Other charges", for service, delivery or table fees and similar):
  - Blank, 0 or 0.00 means "no other charges", and the results show "Other charges 0.00".
  - As an amount: 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places.
  - As a %: 0.01–100, at most 2 decimal places.
- **What each % is of:**
  - Tax % and other charges % are always of the **food subtotal** only.
  - Tax is never charged on other charges or tip.
  - A % tip has a per-bill **"tip on"** option: **food only (default)** or **food + tax**. A tip is never calculated on other charges.
- **Rounding:** tax, other charges and tip are each worked out separately in cents. Any % result is rounded half-up to the cent, so it can be 0.00. A "food + tax" tip uses the already-rounded tax. All money math uses whole cents, never floating-point.
- **Grand total** = food subtotal + tax + other charges + tip.
- **Exactness:** for every bill, the shares add up exactly to the grand total.
- **Results:** totals appear only when **Calculate** is pressed. Changing any input hides the old result until Calculate is pressed again.
- **Currency:** a display symbol only, picked from a fixed list (e.g. $, €, £, ¥, ₹, Rs), with no conversion.
- **Group size:** 1–50 **current** members. Removed members don't count.

## Story list

| ID | Story | Role | Job | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| US-01 | Create an account | Solo diner, Group member | J12 | Not implemented |
| US-02 | Log in | Solo diner, Group member | J12 | Not implemented |
| US-03 | Reset a forgotten password with a recovery code | Solo diner, Group member | J13 | Not implemented |
| US-04 | Keep my bills and groups private | Solo diner, Group member | J12 | Not implemented |
| US-05 | Total a solo bill | Solo diner | J1 | Not implemented |
| US-06 | Choose the currency of a solo bill | Solo diner | J15 | Not implemented |
| US-07 | Save a solo bill to my history | Solo diner | J2 | Not implemented |
| US-08 | Open, edit and delete saved solo bills | Solo diner | J2 | Not implemented |
| US-09 | Create a group | Group member | J6 | Not implemented |
| US-10 | Add friends to a group by name | Group member | J8 | Not implemented |
| US-11 | View and copy the group's invite code | Group member | J8 | Not implemented |
| US-12 | Join a group by claiming my name | Group member | J8 | Not implemented |
| US-13 | Record an equal-split group bill | Group member | J3 | Not implemented |
| US-14 | Record an itemized group bill | Group member | J4 | Not implemented |
| US-15 | Record who paid a group bill | Group member | J5 | Not implemented |
| US-16 | See balances and suggested payments | Group member | J6 | Not implemented |
| US-17 | Record a settle-up | Group member | J7 | Not implemented |
| US-18 | Edit and delete group bills and settle-ups | Group member | J6 | Not implemented |
| US-19 | See the group's activity log | Group member | J9 | Not implemented |
| US-20 | Remove a member from a group | Group member | J10 | Not implemented |
| US-21 | Leave a group | Group member | J10 | Not implemented |
| US-22 | Close out a group as the last member with an account | Group member | J11 | Not implemented |
| US-23 | Restore a removed member | Group member | J10 | Not implemented |
| US-24 | Rejoin a group with the invite code | Group member | J10 | Not implemented |
| US-25 | Get a clear message for every invalid input | Solo diner, Group member | J14 | Not implemented |
| US-26 | Carry on safely after a result or an error | Solo diner, Group member | J14 | Not implemented |
| US-27 | Keep my inputs when saving fails | Solo diner, Group member | J14 | Not implemented |
| US-28 | Keep my records after a server restart | Solo diner, Group member | J2, J6 | Not implemented |
| US-29 | Use the app in my usual browser | Solo diner, Group member | J16 | Not implemented |
| US-30 | Run the app locally from the README | Host | J17 | Not implemented |
| US-31 | Deploy the app to my own server | Host | J18 | Not implemented |
| US-32 | Run all tests with one command | Host | J19 | Not implemented |

---

## Accounts

### US-01 Create an account
**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** to create an account with a username and password, **so that** my bills and groups are kept for me and nobody else.
- **Job:** J12 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a username nobody has used and a valid password, when I sign up, then my account is created, I'm logged in, and a one-time recovery code is shown with a "save this now" warning.
2. Given I leave the recovery code screen, then that code is never shown again.
3. Given a username that is already taken, when I sign up, then I see "That username is taken" and no account is created.
4. Given a blank username or a blank password, when I sign up, then a clear message is shown and no account is created.
5. Given sign-up failed because the username was taken, when I change the username and sign up again, then the account is created without reloading the page.
6. The app never asks for an email address or phone number, and never sends email or text messages.

### US-02 Log in
**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** to log in with my username and password, **so that** only I can reach my records.
- **Job:** J12 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a correct username and password, when I log in, then I'm logged in and see my own bills and groups.
2. Given a wrong password, when I log in, then I see "Username or password is incorrect" and stay logged out.
3. Given a username that doesn't exist, when I log in, then I see the same message, "Username or password is incorrect", which never says whether the username or the password was wrong.
4. Given a failed login, when I enter the correct details and log in again, then I'm logged in without reloading the page.
5. Given many failed login attempts in a row, when I try again, then further attempts are refused for a while with a clear message. (The exact limits are an open question below.)

### US-03 Reset a forgotten password with a recovery code
**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** to set a new password using my recovery code, **so that** I can get back into my account without email or anyone's help.
- **Job:** J13 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given my username, my current recovery code and a new valid password, when I reset, then I can log in with the new password, and a new recovery code is shown once with a "save this now" warning.
2. Given I've reset my password, when I try the old recovery code again, then it no longer works.
3. Given a wrong recovery code, or a username that doesn't exist, when I reset, then a clear message is shown and no password is changed.
4. Given a blank new password, when I reset, then a clear message is shown and the password isn't changed.
5. Given I've lost both my password and my recovery code, then the account can't be recovered. My names in groups stay as they were, and a new account can claim a name again through the group's invite code (US-12, US-24).

### US-04 Keep my bills and groups private
**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** my solo bills to be visible only to me and my groups only to their current members, **so that** nobody else can read or change my money records.
- **Job:** J12 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I'm logged out, when I open any bill or group page (including by typing its address), then I'm sent to the login page and no data is shown.
2. Given I'm logged in, when I type the address of another account's solo bill, then it isn't shown and can't be changed.
3. Given I'm logged in, when I type the address of a group I'm not a current member of (including one I was removed from), then it isn't shown and can't be changed.
4. Given someone sends requests straight to the server, bypassing the page, then the server applies the same rules and returns no private data.

---

## Solo bills

### US-05 Total a solo bill
**As a** Solo diner, **I want** to enter my bill's items, tax, other charges and tip and see the exact total, **so that** I pay the right amount.
- **Job:** J1 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given items 12.50 and 7.50, tax 10%, other charges blank and tip 15% on food, when I press Calculate, then I see subtotal 20.00, tax 2.00, other charges 0.00, tip 3.00 and total 25.00.
2. Given items 12.50 and 7.50, tax 10%, other charges 5% and tip 15% on food, when I press Calculate, then I see subtotal 20.00, tax 2.00, other charges 1.00, tip 3.00 and total 26.00.
3. Given food 100.00, tax 10.00 (amount), other charges blank and tip 15% on food + tax, when I press Calculate, then the tip is 16.50 and the total is 126.50.
4. Given food 100.00, tax 10.00 (amount), other charges 7.50 (amount) and tip 15% on food + tax, when I press Calculate, then other charges is 7.50, the tip is 16.50 (other charges are not tipped on), and the total is 134.00.
5. Given food 100.00, tax 10% and other charges 10%, when I press Calculate, then other charges is 10.00 (a % of the food only, not of food + tax).
6. Given food 33.33 and other charges 12.5%, when I press Calculate, then other charges is 4.17 (4.16625 rounded half-up).
7. Given food 20.00 and tip 12.5%, then the tip is 2.50. Given food 20.00 and tax 8.25%, then the tax is 1.65.
8. Given food 0.01 and other charges 5%, then other charges is 0.00 (rounded half-up) and no error is shown.
9. Given other charges 0 or 0.00, then it's treated as "no other charges", shows 0.00, and causes no error.
10. Given tip 0, then the tip shows 0.00 with no error.
11. Given a new bill, then the "tip on" option starts at food only.
12. Given food 0.01, tax 0, other charges 1,000,000.00 (amount) and tip 0, when I press Calculate, then other charges is 1,000,000.00 and the total is 1,000,000.01.
13. Given no items, when I press Calculate, then I see "Add at least one item" and no result.
14. Given any invalid field (see US-25), when I press Calculate, then no result is shown.

### US-06 Choose the currency of a solo bill
**As a** Solo diner, **I want** to pick the currency symbol for my bill, **so that** amounts are shown the way I paid them.
- **Job:** J15 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a new solo bill, when I pick a currency symbol from the fixed list (e.g. $, €, £, ¥, ₹, Rs), then every amount on the bill is shown with that symbol, and no currency conversion happens.
2. Given an unsaved bill, I can change its currency freely.
3. Given the bill has been saved once, when I edit it, then the currency can't be changed.
4. Given a currency that isn't on the fixed list is sent straight to the server, then it is rejected and nothing is saved.

### US-07 Save a solo bill to my history
**As a** Solo diner, **I want** to save a bill and see it in my history, **so that** I have a record of what I spent.
- **Job:** J2 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a valid solo bill, when I save it, then it appears at the top of my history (newest first) showing its name, date, currency and total.
2. Given I leave the name empty, when I save, then the bill is named "Bill – <date>".
3. Given the bill has an invalid field (see US-25), when I press Save, then the field's message is shown and nothing is saved.
4. Given I have several saved bills, then my history lists them newest first, and shows only my own bills.

### US-08 Open, edit and delete saved solo bills
**As a** Solo diner, **I want** to reopen, fix or remove a saved bill, **so that** my record stays accurate.
- **Job:** J2 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a saved solo bill, when I open it, then every input and result is shown exactly as saved, including other charges and its % / amount setting, and the "tip on" setting.
2. Given I change an amount and save, then the totals are recalculated and checked with the same rules as a new bill. Invalid edits show the same messages and aren't saved.
3. Given I edit other charges (value or % / amount), when I save, then the total is recalculated to match.
4. Given I'm editing a saved bill, then its currency can't be changed.
5. Given I press Delete, then I'm asked to confirm. Cancel keeps the bill unchanged, and Confirm removes it from my history.

---

## Groups

### US-09 Create a group
**As a** Group member, **I want** to create a group for a circle of friends, **so that** we can keep shared costs in one place over time.
- **Job:** J6 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I enter a group name and pick a currency from the fixed list, when I create the group, then I'm its first and only current member, and an invite code is generated automatically.
2. Given I'm choosing the group's currency, then a note tells me it can't be changed after the group is created.
3. Given a group exists, then there's no way to change its currency, either on the page or by sending requests straight to the server.
4. Given a group, then all its bills, settle-ups and balances use the group's single currency.

### US-10 Add friends to a group by name
**As a** Group member, **I want** to add a friend to my group by name only, **so that** I can include them in bills even if they never create an account.
- **Job:** J8 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I add a name-only member "Omar", then Omar can immediately be ticked as a participant, and chosen as the payer of a bill he takes part in.
2. Given the group has 50 current members, when I add another, then I see "A group can have at most 50 members" and nobody is added.
3. Given a name that a current member already has, or a blank name, when I add it, then a clear message is shown and nobody is added.
4. Given 49 current members and some removed members, when I add one more, then it succeeds, because removed members don't count toward the 50.

### US-11 View and copy the group's invite code
**As a** Group member, **I want** to see and copy my group's invite code, **so that** I can pass it to friends who want to take over their own name.
- **Job:** J8 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I'm a current member, when I open the group's invite section, then I see the invite code and a Copy button.
2. Given I press Copy, then the code is copied, ready to paste.
3. Given any group, then there's no option to regenerate or change the invite code. It stays the same for the life of the group.

### US-12 Join a group by claiming my name
**As a** Group member, **I want** to enter a group's invite code and claim the name my friends added for me, **so that** I can see and manage my own part of the group's history.
- **Job:** J8 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given Omar creates an account and enters the group's invite code, when he chooses "I'm Omar", then his account is linked to that member, the group appears in his group list, and he sees the full group history.
2. Given a valid invite code and an account that isn't in the group, when I enter it, then I can choose from all of the group's **unclaimed** members, current or removed. Removed names are marked "(removed)".
3. Given a member already claimed by an account, then that name isn't offered, and no other account can claim it.
4. Given my account already claims a member in this group, then I can't claim a second member in the same group.
5. Given a valid invite code, then there's no option to add myself as a new name. Only current members add new names (US-10).
6. Given a new account claims a removed, unclaimed name, then that member is restored and linked to the account (restore limits from US-23 apply).
7. Given a wrong invite code, when I enter it, then I see "That invite code isn't valid" and join nothing.
8. Given I'm already a current member, when I enter the group's invite code, then I see "You're already in this group" and nothing changes.
9. Given a wrong code was entered, when I enter the correct code, then joining works without reloading the page.

---

## Group bills

### US-13 Record an equal-split group bill
**As a** Group member, **I want** to record a group bill split evenly between the people who took part, **so that** each pays an equal share that adds up exactly to the bill.
- **Job:** J3 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a group of 10 members, when I add a bill with 5 participants, paid by one of them, then only those 5 are charged and the other 5 members' balances don't change.
2. Given a grand total of 100.00 and 3 participants, when I press Calculate, then the shares are 33.34 / 33.33 / 33.33, the first participant in list order is marked as paying the extra cent, and the shares add up to 100.00.
3. Given food 90.00, tax 0, other charges 10% and tip 0, split between 3 participants, when I press Calculate, then other charges is 9.00, the grand total is 99.00, and each share is 33.00.
4. Given food 10.00 and other charges 0.01 (amount), split between 2 participants, then the grand total is 10.01 and the shares are 5.01 and 5.00.
5. Given a grand total of 0.01 split between 2 participants, then the shares are 0.01 and 0.00.
6. Given food 1,000,000.00, tax 0, other charges blank and a 100% tip on food, split between 50 participants, then the grand total is 2,000,000.00, each share is 40,000.00, and the shares add up to the total.
7. Given food 1,000,000.00, tax 0, other charges 1,000,000.00 (amount) and tip 0, split between 3 participants, then the grand total is 2,000,000.00 and the shares are 666,666.67 / 666,666.67 / 666,666.66.
8. Given no participants are selected, when I press Calculate, then I see "Choose who took part" and no result (no division by zero).
9. Given no items, when I press Calculate, then I see "Add at least one item" and no result.
10. Given an equal-split bill, then tax, other charges and tip follow the shared rules above, including the "tip on" option.

### US-14 Record an itemized group bill
**As a** Group member, **I want** to record which items each person had, including shared dishes, **so that** everyone pays for what they had plus a fair part of tax, other charges and tip.
- **Job:** J4 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given Ali has a 40.00 steak and Sara a 10.00 salad, with tax 5.00, other charges blank and tip 10.00, when I press Calculate, then Ali's share is 52.00 and Sara's is 13.00.
2. Given the same bill with other charges 2.50 (amount), then Ali pays 2.00 and Sara 0.50 of the other charges, Ali's share is 54.00, Sara's is 13.50, and they add up to the grand total of 67.50.
3. Given 12.00 nachos ticked for Ali, Sara and Omar, then each is charged 4.00 for the nachos.
4. Given a 10.00 item shared by 3 people, then their parts are 3.34 / 3.33 / 3.33, with the extra cent going to the first ticked person.
5. Given three participants with 10.00 of food each and other charges 0.10, then their other-charges parts are 0.04 / 0.03 / 0.03: the leftover cent goes to the first participant in list order when there's a tie.
6. Given any itemized bill, then tax, other charges and tip are each split separately in proportion to each participant's food subtotal (leftover cents by largest remainder). Each of those parts adds up exactly to the bill's tax, other charges and tip.
7. Given a participant with no items, and other charges of 5.00 on the bill, then that participant's other-charges part is 0.00, and they owe 0.00 in total (food, tax, other charges and tip).
8. Given an item with nobody ticked, when I press Calculate, then I see "Choose who shared this item" next to it and no result.
9. Given any valid itemized bill, then the per-person totals add up exactly to the grand total.

### US-15 Record who paid a group bill
**As a** Group member, **I want** to record which participant paid the bill, **so that** they're credited and the others owe them.
- **Job:** J5 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a bill's participants are Ali and Sara, then the payer list offers only Ali and Sara.
2. Given Omar is chosen as payer and then unticked as a participant, when I press Calculate or Save, then I see "The payer must be one of the people on this bill" and nothing is saved.
3. Given Ali paid 65.00 and the shares are Ali 52.00 and Sara 13.00, then Ali's balance goes up by 13.00 (65.00 paid − his own 52.00 share) and Sara's goes down by 13.00.
4. Given any bill, then exactly one payer is recorded. There is no option for several payers.
5. Given a removed member, then they're never offered as payer or participant on a new bill.

### US-16 See balances and suggested payments
**As a** Group member, **I want** to see each member's running balance and the fewest payments to settle up, **so that** I always know who owes whom.
- **Job:** J6 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given Ali paid 65.00 for a bill with shares Ali 52.00 and Sara 13.00 (and no other activity), then Ali's net balance is +13.00, Sara's is −13.00, and the suggestion reads "Sara pays Ali 13.00".
2. Given any group, then the net balances of all members always add up to exactly 0.00.
3. Given several members owe and are owed, then the suggestions use the fewest payments that bring every balance to 0.00 (largest debtor matched to largest creditor), shown as "X pays Y amount".
4. Given every balance is 0.00, then no suggestions are shown.
5. Given a removed member, then they don't appear in the balance list or the suggestions.

### US-17 Record a settle-up
**As a** Group member, **I want** to record that one member paid another back, **so that** balances reflect repayments.
- **Job:** J7 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given Sara owes Ali 13.00, when I record "Sara paid Ali 13.00", then both balances become 0.00 and the suggestion disappears.
2. Given Sara owes Ali 13.00, when I record "Sara paid Ali 20.00", then Sara's balance is +7.00, Ali's is −7.00, and the suggestion reads "Ali pays Sara 7.00" (overpaying flips the debt).
3. Given a settle-up from a member to the same member, then a clear message is shown and nothing is saved.
4. Given a settle-up amount outside 0.01–1,000,000.00, or with more than 2 decimals, letters or a blank, then a clear message is shown and nothing is saved.
5. Given a removed member, then they're never offered as either person in a new settle-up.
6. Given a settle-up, then it's a record only: no real money is moved.

### US-18 Edit and delete group bills and settle-ups
**As a** Group member, **I want** to correct or remove any group bill or settle-up, **so that** our balances stay right.
- **Job:** J6 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given any current member, then they can edit or delete any bill or settle-up in the group, not just their own.
2. Given I edit a bill or settle-up and save, then it's checked with the same rules as a new one, and the balances update.
3. Given I reopen a group bill with other charges, then its value and % / amount setting are shown exactly as saved, and editing them recalculates the bill and the balances.
4. Given I press Delete on a bill, then I'm asked to confirm. Cancel keeps it, and Confirm removes it and updates the balances.
5. Given a bill or settle-up that includes a removed member, when I try to edit or delete it, then I see "Restore Omar to change this bill" and nothing changes.

### US-19 See the group's activity log
**As a** Group member, **I want** a log of every change in the group, **so that** I can see who did what and when.
- **Job:** J9 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given any member adds, edits or deletes a bill or settle-up, then the activity log shows who did it, when, and what changed (e.g. "Sara edited 'Pizza night': 60.00 → 65.00").
2. Given a member is removed, leaves, is restored or rejoins, then the log shows "X removed Omar", "Omar left", "X restored Omar" or "Omar rejoined with the invite code".
3. Given any current member, then they can see the whole log.

---

## Members leaving and coming back

### US-20 Remove a member from a group
**As a** Group member, **I want** to remove a member who has settled up, **so that** the group lists only the people still in it, without changing past bills.
- **Job:** J10 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a member whose balance isn't 0.00, when anyone tries to remove them, then I see "Settle this member's balance before removing them" and nothing changes.
2. Given Omar's balance is 0.00, when any member removes him, then he moves to "Removed members", and the log records "X removed Omar".
3. Given a member has balance 0.00 but hasn't been removed, then they're still a normal current member (settled isn't the same as removed).
4. Given Omar is removed, when I open "Pizza night" (which he paid for), then it shows "Omar (removed)" as payer and participant, and the bill's totals and everyone's balances are exactly as before.
5. Given Omar is removed, when I add a new bill or settle-up, then he isn't offered as payer, participant or settle-up person, and he isn't in the balance list or the suggestions.
6. Given Omar is removed, when I try to edit or delete a bill or settle-up that includes him, then I see "Restore Omar to change this bill" and nothing changes.
7. Given Omar has an account and is removed, then the group disappears from his group list right away, and opening its address shows that he no longer has access. His account and solo bills are unchanged.

### US-21 Leave a group
**As a** Group member, **I want** to leave a group once I've settled up, **so that** I'm no longer part of it.
- **Job:** J10 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given my balance isn't 0.00 and another current member has an account, when I try to leave, then I see "Settle your balance before leaving" and I stay in the group.
2. Given my balance is 0.00 and another current member has an account, when I leave, then I move to "Removed members", the log records "Omar left", and the group disappears from my group list.
3. Given I've left, then my old bills keep me as "Name (removed)", and every total and balance stays the same.
4. Given I've left, then my account and solo bills are unchanged.
5. Given I'm the last current member with an account, then leaving follows US-22 instead.

### US-22 Close out a group as the last member with an account
**As a** Group member, **I want** to leave a group even when I'm the last member with an account, after a clear warning, **so that** a group nobody uses is closed for good.
- **Job:** J11 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I'm the only current member with an account, when I press Leave, then I see: "You're the last member with an account. If you leave, this group and all its bills, settle-ups and history will be permanently deleted. Unsettled balances will be lost."
2. Given that warning, when I press Cancel, then nothing changes.
3. Given that warning, when I press Leave (whatever my balance), then the group is permanently deleted, including its members, bills, settle-ups, activity log and invite code.
4. Given a group was deleted, then it disappears for everyone, its address shows "This group no longer exists", and its invite code is no longer valid.
5. Given a group was deleted, then my account, my solo bills and my other groups are unchanged.
6. Given any group, then there's no separate "delete group" button. Deletion only happens this way.

### US-23 Restore a removed member
**As a** Group member, **I want** to bring back a member who was removed, **so that** they can take part again with one continuous history.
- **Job:** J10 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given the group has removed members, then the members page lists them under "Removed members", each with a Restore button that any current member can use.
2. Given Omar is removed, when any member presses Restore, then he's a current member again with his full history and no "(removed)" mark, and the log records "X restored Omar".
3. Given Omar had an account, when he's restored, then his access to the group returns.
4. Given Omar is restored, then bills and settle-ups that include him can be edited and deleted again.
5. Given the group already has 50 current members, when anyone tries to restore Omar, then a clear message is shown and he stays removed.
6. Given a current member is already named Omar, when anyone tries to restore Omar, then a clear message is shown and he stays removed.

### US-24 Rejoin a group with the invite code
**As a** Group member, **I want** to rejoin a group I was removed from by entering its invite code, **so that** I can come back without waiting for someone to restore me.
- **Job:** J10 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given Omar has an account and was removed, when he enters the group's invite code, then he's restored automatically with his full history and access, and the log records "Omar rejoined with the invite code".
2. Given the group has 50 current members, or a current member is already named Omar, when Omar enters the invite code, then a clear message is shown and he stays removed.
3. Given a group was deleted (US-22), when its old invite code is entered, then I see "That invite code isn't valid".

---

## Input checks, results and saving (all bills)

### US-25 Get a clear message for every invalid input
**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** a clear message next to any field I've filled in wrongly, **so that** I never get a wrong result or a crash.
- **Job:** J14 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a money field containing "abc", "-5", "1.234", "1000000.01" or a blank, when I press Calculate or Save, then a message next to that field explains the rule and no result is shown.
2. Given a money field of exactly 0.01 or exactly 1,000,000.00, then it's accepted.
3. Given tax or tip as a % outside 0–100 (e.g. -1 or 100.01), then a clear message is shown and no result.
4. Given tax or tip as a % of exactly 0 or exactly 100, then it's accepted.
5. Given a tax or tip % with more than 2 decimal places (e.g. 12.345), then a clear message is shown and no result.
6. Given tax or tip as an amount outside 0.00–1,000,000.00, or with letters or more than 2 decimals, then a clear message is shown and no result.
7. Given other charges as an amount of "abc", "-1", "0.001" or "1000000.01", then "Other charges must be between 0.01 and 1,000,000.00, or left empty" appears next to the field and no result is shown.
8. Given other charges as a % of "abc", "-5", "0.001" or "100.01", then "Other charges must be between 0.01% and 100%, or left empty" appears next to the field and no result is shown.
9. Given other charges of exactly 0.01 or 1,000,000.00 (amount), or exactly 0.01% or 100%, then it's accepted.
10. Given any input at all, then the app never shows NaN, Infinity, "undefined", or a blank or crashed screen.
11. Given invalid data is sent straight to the server, bypassing the page, then the server rejects it and saves nothing.

### US-26 Carry on safely after a result or an error
**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** results and errors to update correctly as I keep working, **so that** I never act on an out-of-date figure.
- **Job:** J14 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given an error is showing, when I fix the field and press Calculate, then the error disappears and the correct result appears, with no page reload needed.
2. Given a result is showing, when I change any input, then the old result is hidden until I press Calculate again.
3. Given a result is showing, when I switch tax, tip or other charges between % and amount, or change the "tip on" option, then the old result is hidden until I press Calculate again.
4. Given I press Calculate several times without changing anything, then the same result is shown each time.

### US-27 Keep my inputs when saving fails
**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** my entries kept if a save fails, **so that** I don't have to type everything again.
- **Job:** J14 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given the server can't be reached, when I save, then I see "Couldn't save — check your connection" and all my inputs are kept.
2. Given a save failed, when the server is reachable again and I press Save, then the bill is saved normally.

### US-28 Keep my records after a server restart
**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** my bills, groups and balances to still be there after the app's server restarts, **so that** my history is never lost.
- **Jobs:** J2, J6 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I've saved solo bills, groups, group bills and settle-ups, when the server is stopped and started again, then all of them, and all balances and activity logs, are exactly as before.

### US-29 Use the app in my usual browser
**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** the app to work in the current version of my usual browser, **so that** I don't need to install anything.
- **Job:** J16 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given the current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, when I use every feature above, then it behaves the same way and every acceptance criterion passes.

---

## Running the app

### US-30 Run the app locally from the README
**As a** Host, **I want** to install and start the app on my computer by following the README, **so that** I can try it for free.
- **Job:** J17 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given Node.js LTS is installed, when I follow the README steps on a fresh clone (install, start, open the address), then the app runs and I can sign up locally.
2. Given the README, then it never asks for a paid account, an API key, or any third-party cloud or paid service.
3. Given the app is running, then it works with no internet-based service: accounts, data storage and calculations all happen inside the app and its own database file.

### US-31 Deploy the app to my own server
**As a** Host, **I want** to run the same app on a server, **so that** my friends can use it for real.
- **Job:** J18 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a server with Node.js LTS, when I deploy the same build, then it runs, configured only through settings the app owns: port, database file location and session secret.
2. Given the deployed app, then it doesn't depend on any third-party cloud or paid service.
3. Given the deployed app, then passwords are stored hashed (never as plain text), and sessions use secure cookies.

### US-32 Run all tests with one command
**As a** Host, **I want** to run every automated test with one command, **so that** I can see for myself that the app works as described.
- **Job:** J19 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given the project is installed, when I run the single test command from the README, then the calculation, validation and server tests and the browser tests (Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, Safari's engine) all run and pass.

---

## Open questions

The spec doesn't settle these yet. Each one needs a decision before the related story can be marked Implemented.

1. **Username and password rules:** minimum and maximum length, and which characters are allowed (US-01, US-03).
2. **Login rate limiting:** how many failed attempts, and for how long further attempts are refused (US-02, criterion 5).
3. **Name rules for groups, bills, items and members:** required or optional, and maximum length (US-07, US-09, US-10, US-13, US-14). The spec only says a solo bill's name is optional.
4. **Limit on totals:** the 1,000,000.00 limit applies to each money field. It isn't clear whether the food subtotal or grand total may go above it (US-13 examples reach 2,000,000.00).
5. **Maximum number of items per bill** (US-05, US-13, US-14).
6. **Logging out:** the spec doesn't mention it (US-02).
7. **Activity log scope:** whether adding members, claiming names and creating the group are also logged (US-19).
8. **Full currency list:** the spec gives examples ($, €, £, ¥, ₹, Rs), not the complete list (US-06, US-09).

## Spec details carried over

These criteria are not written word-for-word in the spec. Each one follows directly from a spec rule:
- No duplicate or blank member names when adding (US-10). This follows from the spec's rule that restoring is refused when a current member has the same name.
- "Add at least one item" for group bills (US-13). Every bill has the same four money parts, starting with items.
- Removed members' bills become editable again after restore (US-23). The spec makes them view-only only "while a member is removed".

# User Stories

How the Bill Splitting Calculator helps each role get their jobs done. Every story names its role (from [app-roles.md](app-roles.md)) and the job it serves (from [jobs-to-be-done.md](jobs-to-be-done.md)), and has testable acceptance criteria and a status.

## How to read this file

- **Template:** "As a [role], I want [capability], so that [benefit]."
- **Acceptance criteria:** written as "Given [starting state], when [action], then [observable result]". They cover:
  - the normal case
  - invalid input
  - boundary values
  - very large and very small numbers
  - what happens when the user carries on after a result or an error
- **Status:** **Implemented** means the running app does exactly what every criterion says today. **Not implemented** means it doesn't yet. No app code exists yet, so every story is currently **Not implemented**.
- **Money format:** amounts are shown with 2 decimals and the bill's or group's currency symbol. The examples below leave out the symbol.

## Shared rules used by many stories

These rules come from the spec and apply wherever a story mentions them.

- **Money fields** (item prices, settle-up amounts): 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places. No negatives, letters, blanks or extra decimals.
- **Tax and tip:** each can be a **%** (0–100, at most 2 decimal places, e.g. 12.5 or 8.25) or an **amount** (0.00–1,000,000.00). Tip may be 0.
- **Other charges** (optional, one field per bill, always labelled "Other charges", for service, delivery or table fees and similar):
  - Blank, 0 or 0.00 means "no other charges", and the results show "Other charges 0.00".
  - As an amount: 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places.
  - As a %: 0.01–100, at most 2 decimal places.
- **What each % is of:**
  - Tax % and other charges % are always of the **food subtotal** only.
  - Tax is never charged on other charges or tip.
  - A % tip has a per-bill **"tip on"** option: **food only (default)** or **food + tax**. A tip is never calculated on other charges.
- **Rounding:** tax, other charges and tip are each worked out separately in cents. Any % result is rounded half-up to the cent, so it can be 0.00. A "food + tax" tip uses the already-rounded tax. All money math uses whole cents, never floating-point.
- **Grand total** = food subtotal + tax + other charges + tip.
- **Exactness:** for every bill, the shares add up exactly to the grand total.
- **Results:** totals appear only when **Calculate** is pressed. Changing any input hides the old result until Calculate is pressed again.
- **Currency:** a display symbol only, picked from a fixed list (e.g. $, €, £, ¥, ₹, Rs), with no conversion.
- **Group size:** 1–50 **current** members. Removed members don't count.

## Accounts

### US-01 Create an account
**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** to create an account with a username and password, **so that** my bills and groups are kept for me and nobody else.
- **Job:** J12 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a username nobody has used and a valid password, when I sign up, then my account is created, I'm logged in, and a one-time recovery code is shown with a "save this now" warning.
2. Given I leave the recovery code screen, then that code is never shown again.
3. Given a username that is already taken, when I sign up, then I see "That username is taken" and no account is created.
4. Given a blank username or a blank password, when I sign up, then a clear message is shown and no account is created.
5. Given sign-up failed because the username was taken, when I change the username and sign up again, then the account is created without reloading the page.
6. The app never asks for an email address or phone number, and never sends email or text messages.

### US-02 Log in
**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** to log in with my username and password, **so that** only I can reach my records.
- **Job:** J12 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a correct username and password, when I log in, then I'm logged in and see my own bills and groups.
2. Given a wrong password, when I log in, then I see "Username or password is incorrect" and stay logged out.
3. Given a username that doesn't exist, when I log in, then I see the same message, "Username or password is incorrect", which never says whether the username or the password was wrong.
4. Given a failed login, when I enter the correct details and log in again, then I'm logged in without reloading the page.
5. Given many failed login attempts in a row, when I try again, then further attempts are refused for a while with a clear message. (The exact limits are an open question below.)

### US-03 Reset a forgotten password with a recovery code
**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** to set a new password using my recovery code, **so that** I can get back into my account without email or anyone's help.
- **Job:** J13 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given my username, my current recovery code and a new valid password, when I reset, then I can log in with the new password, and a new recovery code is shown once with a "save this now" warning.
2. Given I've reset my password, when I try the old recovery code again, then it no longer works.
3. Given a wrong recovery code, or a username that doesn't exist, when I reset, then a clear message is shown and no password is changed.
4. Given a blank new password, when I reset, then a clear message is shown and the password isn't changed.
5. Given I've lost both my password and my recovery code, then the account can't be recovered. My names in groups stay as they were, and a new account can claim a name again through the group's invite code (US-12, US-24).

### US-04 Keep my bills and groups private
**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** my solo bills to be visible only to me and my groups only to their current members, **so that** nobody else can read or change my money records.
- **Job:** J12 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I'm logged out, when I open any bill or group page (including by typing its address), then I'm sent to the login page and no data is shown.
2. Given I'm logged in, when I type the address of another account's solo bill, then it isn't shown and can't be changed.
3. Given I'm logged in, when I type the address of a group I'm not a current member of (including one I was removed from), then it isn't shown and can't be changed.
4. Given someone sends requests straight to the server, bypassing the page, then the server applies the same rules and returns no private data.

**As a** Solo diner, **I want** to enter my bill's items, tax, other charges and tip and see the exact total, **so that** I pay the right amount.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given items 12.50 and 7.50, tax 10%, other charges blank and tip 15% on food, when I press Calculate, then I see subtotal 20.00, tax 2.00, other charges 0.00, tip 3.00 and total 25.00.
2. Given items 12.50 and 7.50, tax 10%, other charges 5% and tip 15% on food, when I press Calculate, then I see subtotal 20.00, tax 2.00, other charges 1.00, tip 3.00 and total 26.00.
3. Given food 100.00, tax 10.00 (amount), other charges blank and tip 15% on food + tax, when I press Calculate, then the tip is 16.50 and the total is 126.50.
4. Given food 100.00, tax 10.00 (amount), other charges 7.50 (amount) and tip 15% on food + tax, when I press Calculate, then other charges is 7.50, the tip is 16.50 (other charges are not tipped on), and the total is 134.00.
5. Given food 100.00, tax 10% and other charges 10%, when I press Calculate, then other charges is 10.00 (a % of the food only, not of food + tax).
6. Given food 33.33 and other charges 12.5%, when I press Calculate, then other charges is 4.17 (4.16625 rounded half-up).
7. Given food 20.00 and tip 12.5%, then the tip is 2.50. Given food 20.00 and tax 8.25%, then the tax is 1.65.
8. Given food 0.01 and other charges 5%, then other charges is 0.00 (rounded half-up) and no error is shown.
9. Given other charges 0 or 0.00, then it's treated as "no other charges", shows 0.00, and causes no error.
10. Given tip 0, then the tip shows 0.00 with no error.
11. Given a new bill, then the "tip on" option starts at food only.
12. Given food 0.01, tax 0, other charges 1,000,000.00 (amount) and tip 0, when I press Calculate, then other charges is 1,000,000.00 and the total is 1,000,000.01.
13. Given no items, when I press Calculate, then I see "Add at least one item" and no result.
14. Given any invalid field (see US-25), when I press Calculate, then no result is shown.

### US-06 Choose the currency of a solo bill
**As a** Solo diner, **I want** to pick the currency symbol for my bill, **so that** amounts are shown the way I paid them.
- **Job:** J15 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a new solo bill, when I pick a currency symbol from the fixed list (e.g. $, €, £, ¥, ₹, Rs), then every amount on the bill is shown with that symbol, and no currency conversion happens.
2. Given an unsaved bill, I can change its currency freely.
3. Given the bill has been saved once, when I edit it, then the currency can't be changed.
4. Given a currency that isn't on the fixed list is sent straight to the server, then it is rejected and nothing is saved.

### US-07 Save a solo bill to my history
**As a** Solo diner, **I want** to save a bill and see it in my history, **so that** I have a record of what I spent.
- **Job:** J2 · **Status:** Not implemented

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a valid solo bill, when I save it, then it appears at the top of my history (newest first) showing its name, date, currency and total.
2. Given I leave the name empty, when I save, then the bill is named "Bill – <date>".
3. Given the bill has an invalid field (see US-25), when I press Save, then the field's message is shown and nothing is saved.
4. Given I have several saved bills, then my history lists them newest first, and shows only my own bills.

### US-08 Open, edit and delete saved solo bills
**As a** Solo diner, **I want** to reopen, fix or remove a saved bill, **so that** my record stays accurate.

1. Given a saved solo bill, when I open it, then every input and result is shown exactly as saved, including other charges and its % / amount setting, and the "tip on" setting.
2. Given I change an amount and save, then the totals are recalculated and checked with the same rules as a new bill. Invalid edits show the same messages and aren't saved.
3. Given I edit other charges (value or % / amount), when I save, then the total is recalculated to match.
4. Given I'm editing a saved bill, then its currency can't be changed.
5. Given I press Delete, then I'm asked to confirm. Cancel keeps the bill unchanged, and Confirm removes it from my history.

8. Given I'm already a current member, when I enter the group's invite code, then I see "You're already in this group" and nothing changes.
9. Given a wrong code was entered, when I enter the correct code, then joining works without reloading the page.

### US-13 Record an equal-split group bill
**As a** Group member, **I want** to record a group bill split evenly between the people who took part, **so that** each pays an equal share that adds up exactly to the bill.
