schema.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Simulator only: this tool cannot drive or stream a physical iPhone or iPad. If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Start more than 4pt from the edge to drag or scroll content near the bezel.

bundle_id.description: For 'launch': bundle identifier. If omitted, extracted from the .app's Info.plist.

points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000, total clamped to 30s).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. Each sample carries both contacts (x1/y1, x2/y2); first is touch-down, last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000, total clamped to 30s).

duration.description: Seconds. For 'tap', >0.5 is a long-press. For 'swipe', the gesture duration (default 0.3).

name.description: For 'button': hardware button to press.

1	# User Stories
2	
3	How the Bill Splitting Calculator helps each role get their jobs done. Every story names its role (from [app-roles.md](app-roles.md)) and the job it serves (from [jobs-to-be-done.md](jobs-to-be-done.md)), and has testable acceptance criteria and a status.
4	
5	## How to read this file
6	
7	- **Template:** "As a [role], I want [capability], so that [benefit]."
8	- **Acceptance criteria:** written as "Given [starting state], when [action], then [observable result]". They cover:
9	  - the normal case
10	  - invalid input
11	  - boundary values
12	  - very large and very small numbers
13	  - what happens when the user carries on after a result or an error
14	- **Status:** **Implemented** means the running app does exactly what every criterion says today. **Not implemented** means it doesn't yet. No app code exists yet, so every story is currently **Not implemented**.
15	- **Money format:** amounts are shown with 2 decimals and the bill's or group's currency symbol. The examples below leave out the symbol.
16	
17	## Shared rules used by many stories
18	
19	These rules come from the spec and apply wherever a story mentions them.
20	
21	- **Money fields** (item prices, settle-up amounts): 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places. No negatives, letters, blanks or extra decimals.
22	- **Per-field limit:** the 1,000,000.00 limit applies to each field on its own. A bill's food subtotal and grand total may be larger.
23	- **Items:** every bill (solo, equal or itemized) needs 1–200 items. The largest possible grand total is 1,000,000,000.00, and it is still exact to the cent.
24	- **Names** (spaces at the start and end are trimmed before checking):
25	  - Group name: required, 1–50 characters.
26	  - Member name: required, 1–30 characters, and never reused within a group: it can't match any member the group has ever had, current or removed. Not case-sensitive: "omar" clashes with "Omar".
27	  - Bill name: optional, up to 60 characters, defaulting to "Bill – date".
28	  - Item name: optional, up to 40 characters, defaulting to "Item 1", "Item 2" and so on.
29	- **Tax and tip:** each can be a **%** (0–100, at most 2 decimal places, e.g. 12.5 or 8.25) or an **amount** (0.00–1,000,000.00). Tip may be 0.
30	- **Other charges** (optional, one field per bill, always labelled "Other charges", for service, delivery or table fees and similar):
31	  - Blank, 0 or 0.00 means "no other charges", and the results show "Other charges 0.00".
32	  - As an amount: 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places.
33	  - As a %: 0.01–100, at most 2 decimal places.
34	- **What each % is of:**
35	  - Tax % and other charges % are always of the **food subtotal** only.
36	  - Tax is never charged on other charges or tip.
37	  - A % tip has a per-bill **"tip on"** option: **food only (default)** or **food + tax**. A tip is never calculated on other charges.
38	- **Rounding:** tax, other charges and tip are each worked out separately in cents. Any % result is rounded half-up to the cent, so it can be 0.00. A "food + tax" tip uses the already-rounded tax. All money math uses whole cents, never floating-point.
39	- **Grand total** = food subtotal + tax + other charges + tip.
40	- **Exactness:** for every bill, the shares add up exactly to the grand total.
41	- **Results:** totals appear only when **Calculate** is pressed. Changing any input hides the old result until Calculate is pressed again.
42	- **Currency:** a display symbol only, with no conversion. Choose from the default list of 12 ($, €, £, ¥, ₹, Rs, ₩, ₺, R$, CHF, AED, SAR), or choose "Other" and type a symbol of 1–3 characters with no digits.
43	- **Accounts:**
44	  - Username: 3–30 characters (letters, numbers, underscore), not case-sensitive.
45	  - Password: 8–128 characters, any characters.
46	  - A session ends on Log out or after 30 days without use.
47	  - There is no limit on failed login or recovery-code attempts.
48	- **Group size:** 1–50 **current** members. Removed members don't count.
49	- **Language and number display:**
50	  - All text is in English.
51	  - Amounts are shown with a thousands comma and 2 decimals ("1,000,000.00").
52	  - The currency symbol goes before the amount ("$12.50"), with a space for symbols made of letters ("Rs 400.00", "CHF 12.00").
53	  - Typing "1,000.50" is accepted as 1000.50, while European style ("1.000,50") is rejected.
54	- **Layout:** desktop-first, and fully usable on phones down to 360 px wide.
55	
56	## Story list
57	
58	| ID | Story | Role | Job | Status |
59	|---|---|---|---|---|
60	| US-01 | Create an account | Solo diner, Group member | J12 | Not implemented |
61	| US-02 | Log in and log out | Solo diner, Group member | J12 | Not implemented |
62	| US-03 | Reset a forgotten password with a recovery code | Solo diner, Group member | J13 | Not implemented |
63	| US-04 | Keep my bills and groups private | Solo diner, Group member | J12 | Not implemented |
64	| US-05 | Total a solo bill | Solo diner | J1 | Not implemented |
65	| US-06 | Choose the currency of a solo bill | Solo diner | J15 | Not implemented |
66	| US-07 | Save a solo bill to my history | Solo diner | J2 | Not implemented |
67	| US-08 | Open, edit and delete saved solo bills | Solo diner | J2 | Not implemented |
68	| US-09 | Create a group | Group member | J6 | Not implemented |
69	| US-10 | Add friends to a group by name | Group member | J8 | Not implemented |
70	| US-11 | View and copy the group's invite code | Group member | J8 | Not implemented |
71	| US-12 | Join a group by claiming my name | Group member | J8 | Not implemented |
72	| US-13 | Record an equal-split group bill | Group member | J3 | Not implemented |
73	| US-14 | Record an itemized group bill | Group member | J4 | Not implemented |
74	| US-15 | Record who paid a group bill | Group member | J5 | Not implemented |
75	| US-16 | See balances and suggested payments | Group member | J6 | Not implemented |
76	| US-17 | Record a settle-up | Group member | J7 | Not implemented |
77	| US-18 | Edit and delete group bills and settle-ups | Group member | J6 | Not implemented |
78	| US-19 | See the group's activity log | Group member | J9 | Not implemented |
79	| US-20 | Remove a member from a group | Group member | J10 | Not implemented |
80	| US-21 | Leave a group | Group member | J10 | Not implemented |
81	| US-22 | Close out a group as the last member with an account | Group member | J11 | Not implemented |
82	| US-23 | Restore a removed member | Group member | J10 | Not implemented |
83	| US-24 | Rejoin a group with the invite code | Group member | J10 | Not implemented |
84	| US-25 | Get a clear message for every invalid input | Solo diner, Group member | J14 | Not implemented |
85	| US-26 | Carry on safely after a result or an error | Solo diner, Group member | J14 | Not implemented |
86	| US-27 | Keep my inputs when saving fails | Solo diner, Group member | J14 | Not implemented |
87	| US-28 | Keep my records after a restart | Solo diner, Group member | J2, J6 | Not implemented |
88	| US-29 | Use the app in my usual browser | Solo diner, Group member | J16 | Not implemented |
89	| US-33 | See my money at a glance on the Dashboard | Solo diner, Group member | J20 | Not implemented |
90	| US-34 | Find my way on a computer or a phone | Solo diner, Group member | J16 | Not implemented |
91	| US-35 | Choose light or dark appearance | Solo diner, Group member | J21 | Not implemented |
92	| US-36 | Use the app with a keyboard, screen reader or zoom | Solo diner, Group member | J22 | Not implemented |
93	| US-37 | Know what happened after every action | Solo diner, Group member | J14 | Not implemented |
94	| US-38 | Don't lose unsaved changes by accident | Solo diner, Group member | J14 | Not implemented |
95	| US-30 | Run the app locally from the README | Host | J17 | Not implemented |
96	| US-31 | Deploy the app to my own server | Host | J18 | Not implemented |
97	| US-32 | Run all tests with one command | Host | J19 | Not implemented |
98	
99	---
100	
101	## Accounts
102	
103	### US-01 Create an account
104	**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** to create an account with a username and password, **so that** my bills and groups are kept for me and nobody else.
105	- **Job:** J12 · **Status:** Not implemented
106	
107	Acceptance criteria:
108	1. Given a username nobody has used and a valid password, when I sign up, then my account is created, I'm logged in, and a one-time recovery code is shown with a "save this now" warning.
109	2. Given I leave the recovery code screen, then that code is never shown again.
110	3. Given a username that is already taken, when I sign up, then I see "That username is taken" and no account is created.
111	4. Given "Sana" already exists, when someone signs up as "sana" or "SANA", then they see "That username is taken" (usernames aren't case-sensitive).
112	5. Given a username that is blank, 2 characters or 31 characters long, or contains anything other than letters, numbers and underscore (e.g. "sana!" or "sa na"), when I sign up, then a clear message is shown and no account is created.
113	6. Given a username of exactly 3 or exactly 30 characters, then it's accepted.
114	7. Given a password that is blank, 7 characters or 129 characters long, when I sign up, then a clear message is shown and no account is created.
115	8. Given a password of exactly 8 or exactly 128 characters, including spaces and symbols, then it's accepted.
116	9. Given sign-up failed (e.g. the username was taken), when I fix it and sign up again, then the account is created without reloading the page.
117	10. The app never asks for an email address or phone number, and never sends email or text messages.
118	
119	### US-02 Log in and log out
120	**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** to log in with my username and password and log out when I'm done, **so that** only I can reach my records, even on a shared computer.
121	- **Job:** J12 · **Status:** Not implemented
122	
123	Acceptance criteria:
124	1. Given a correct username and password, when I log in, then I'm logged in and see my own bills and groups.
125	2. Given a wrong password, when I log in, then I see "Username or password is incorrect" and stay logged out.
126	3. Given a username that doesn't exist, when I log in, then I see the same message, "Username or password is incorrect", which never says whether the username or the password was wrong.
127	4. Given a failed login, when I enter the correct details and log in again, then I'm logged in without reloading the page.
128	5. Given my account is "Sana", when I log in as "sana" or "SANA" with the right password, then I'm logged in.
129	6. Given 20 wrong passwords in a row, when I then enter the correct one, then I'm logged in. There's no limit on attempts.
130	7. Given I'm logged in, when I press Log out, then I'm logged out at once, and opening any bill or group page sends me to the login page.
131	8. Given I've used the app within the last 30 days, when I return, then I'm still logged in.
132	9. Given I haven't used the app for 30 days, when I return, then I must log in again.
133	
134	### US-03 Reset a forgotten password with a recovery code
135	**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** to set a new password using my recovery code, **so that** I can get back into my account without email or anyone's help.
136	- **Job:** J13 · **Status:** Not implemented
137	
138	Acceptance criteria:
139	1. Given my username, my current recovery code and a new valid password, when I reset, then I can log in with the new password, and a new recovery code is shown once with a "save this now" warning.
140	2. Given I've reset my password, when I try the old recovery code again, then it no longer works.
141	3. Given a wrong recovery code, or a username that doesn't exist, when I reset, then a clear message is shown and no password is changed.
142	4. Given a new password that is blank, 7 characters or 129 characters long, when I reset, then a clear message is shown and the password isn't changed.
143	5. Given many wrong recovery codes in a row, when I then enter the right one, then the reset works. There's no limit on attempts.
144	6. Given I've lost both my password and my recovery code, then the account can't be recovered. My names in groups stay as they were, and a new account can claim a name again through the group's invite code (US-12, US-24).
145	
146	### US-04 Keep my bills and groups private
147	**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** my solo bills to be visible only to me and my groups only to their current members, **so that** nobody else can read or change my money records.
148	- **Job:** J12 · **Status:** Not implemented
149	
150	Acceptance criteria:
151	1. Given I'm logged out, when I open any bill or group page (including by typing its address), then I'm sent to the login page and no data is shown.
152	2. Given I'm logged in, when I type the address of another account's solo bill, then it isn't shown and can't be changed.
153	3. Given I'm logged in, when I type the address of a group I'm not a current member of (including one I was removed from), then it isn't shown and can't be changed.
154	4. Given someone sends requests straight to the server, bypassing the page, then the server applies the same rules and returns no private data.
155	
156	---
157	
158	## Solo bills
159	
160	### US-05 Total a solo bill
161	**As a** Solo diner, **I want** to enter my bill's items, tax, other charges and tip and see the exact total, **so that** I pay the right amount.
162	- **Job:** J1 · **Status:** Not implemented
163	
164	Acceptance criteria:
165	1. Given items 12.50 and 7.50, tax 10%, other charges blank and tip 15% on food, when I press Calculate, then I see subtotal 20.00, tax 2.00, other charges 0.00, tip 3.00 and total 25.00.
166	2. Given items 12.50 and 7.50, tax 10%, other charges 5% and tip 15% on food, when I press Calculate, then I see subtotal 20.00, tax 2.00, other charges 1.00, tip 3.00 and total 26.00.
167	3. Given food 100.00, tax 10.00 (amount), other charges blank and tip 15% on food + tax, when I press Calculate, then the tip is 16.50 and the total is 126.50.
168	4. Given food 100.00, tax 10.00 (amount), other charges 7.50 (amount) and tip 15% on food + tax, when I press Calculate, then other charges is 7.50, the tip is 16.50 (other charges are not tipped on), and the total is 134.00.
169	5. Given food 100.00, tax 10% and other charges 10%, when I press Calculate, then other charges is 10.00 (a % of the food only, not of food + tax).
170	6. Given food 33.33 and other charges 12.5%, when I press Calculate, then other charges is 4.17 (4.16625 rounded half-up).
171	7. Given food 20.00 and tip 12.5%, then the tip is 2.50. Given food 20.00 and tax 8.25%, then the tax is 1.65.
172	8. Given food 0.01 and other charges 5%, then other charges is 0.00 (rounded half-up) and no error is shown.
173	9. Given other charges 0 or 0.00, then it's treated as "no other charges", shows 0.00, and causes no error.
174	10. Given tip 0, then the tip shows 0.00 with no error.
175	11. Given a new bill, then the "tip on" option starts at food only.
176	12. Given food 0.01, tax 0, other charges 1,000,000.00 (amount) and tip 0, when I press Calculate, then other charges is 1,000,000.00 and the total is 1,000,000.01.
177	13. Given no items, when I press Calculate, then I see "Add at least one item" and no result.
178	14. Given any invalid field (see US-25), when I press Calculate, then no result is shown.
179	
180	### US-06 Choose the currency of a solo bill
181	**As a** Solo diner, **I want** to pick the currency symbol for my bill, **so that** amounts are shown the way I paid them.
182	- **Job:** J15 · **Status:** Not implemented
183	
184	Acceptance criteria:
185	1. Given a new solo bill, when I open the currency picker, then it offers exactly $, €, £, ¥, ₹, Rs, ₩, ₺, R$, CHF, AED, SAR and "Other".
186	2. Given I pick a symbol from the list, then every amount on the bill is shown with that symbol, and no currency conversion happens.
187	3. Given I pick "Other" and type "kr" or "zł", then every amount is shown with that symbol.
188	4. Given "Other" with a blank symbol, a symbol of 4+ characters (e.g. "abcd") or one containing a digit (e.g. "R1"), when I press Calculate or Save, then I see "Currency symbol must be 1–3 characters with no digits" and nothing is saved.
189	5. Given "Other" with " kr " (spaces around it), then it's saved as "kr".
190	6. Given an unsaved bill, I can change its currency freely.
191	7. Given the bill has been saved once, when I edit it, then the currency can't be changed.
192	8. Given an invalid currency symbol is sent straight to the server, then it's rejected and nothing is saved.
193	
194	### US-07 Save a solo bill to my history
195	**As a** Solo diner, **I want** to save a bill and see it in my history, **so that** I have a record of what I spent.
196	- **Job:** J2 · **Status:** Not implemented
197	
198	Acceptance criteria:
199	1. Given a valid solo bill, when I save it, then it appears at the top of my history (newest first) showing its name, date, currency and total.
200	2. Given I leave the name empty, when I save, then the bill is named "Bill – date" (using the bill's date).
201	3. Given a bill name of exactly 60 characters, then it's accepted. A name of 61 or more characters shows a clear message and the bill isn't saved.
202	4. Given the bill has an invalid field (see US-25), when I press Save, then the field's message is shown and nothing is saved.
203	5. Given I have several saved bills, then my history lists them newest first, and shows only my own bills.
204	
205	### US-08 Open, edit and delete saved solo bills
206	**As a** Solo diner, **I want** to reopen, fix or remove a saved bill, **so that** my record stays accurate.
207	- **Job:** J2 · **Status:** Not implemented
208	
209	Acceptance criteria:
210	1. Given a saved solo bill, when I open it, then every input and result is shown exactly as saved, including other charges and its % / amount setting, and the "tip on" setting.
211	2. Given I change an amount and save, then the totals are recalculated and checked with the same rules as a new bill. Invalid edits show the same messages and aren't saved.
212	3. Given I edit other charges (value or % / amount), when I save, then the total is recalculated to match.
213	4. Given I'm editing a saved bill, then its currency can't be changed.
214	5. Given I press Delete, then I'm asked to confirm. Cancel keeps the bill unchanged, and Confirm removes it from my history.
215	
216	---
217	
218	## Groups
219	
220	### US-09 Create a group
221	**As a** Group member, **I want** to create a group for a circle of friends, **so that** we can keep shared costs in one place over time.
222	- **Job:** J6 · **Status:** Not implemented
223	
224	Acceptance criteria:

526	1. Given the appearance setting is "Device" (the default) and my device is in dark mode, then the app is dark. When the device switches to light mode, the app follows.
527	2. Given I choose "Light" or "Dark" on the Account page, then the app uses that look regardless of my device setting.
528	3. Given I chose "Dark", when I log out and back in (on any computer), then the app is still dark, because the choice is saved with my account.
529	4. Given either theme, then all text has at least 4.5:1 contrast, and owed / owes amounts keep their "+" / "−" and words as well as colour.
530	
531	### US-36 Use the app with a keyboard, screen reader or zoom
532	**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** every feature to work without a mouse, with a screen reader and at large text sizes, **so that** I can manage my money on my own.
533	- **Job:** J22 · **Status:** Not implemented
534	
535	Acceptance criteria:
536	1. Given I use only the keyboard, then I can sign up, log in, create a group, add members, add an itemized bill (including choosing people in the item dropdowns), calculate, save, record a settle-up and log out, with a clearly visible focus outline at every step.
537	2. Given a confirmation dialog is open, then keyboard focus stays inside it, and Esc closes it the same way as Cancel.
538	3. Given a screen reader, then every field has a label, each error is read out with its field, and new results and success messages are announced.
539	4. Given 200% browser zoom, then every page is still usable with no lost content or functions.
540	5. Given any button, link or tick box, then its touch or click area is at least 24×24 px.
541	6. Given any page in light or dark mode, when the automated accessibility checks run as part of `npm test`, then they report no WCAG 2.2 AA violations.
542	
543	### US-37 Know what happened after every action
544	**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** clear signs when something is saving, saved, loading or empty, **so that** I'm never unsure whether it worked and never save something twice.
545	- **Job:** J14 · **Status:** Not implemented
546	
547	Acceptance criteria:
548	1. Given I save a bill, record a payment or remove a member, then a short corner message appears ("Bill saved", "Payment recorded", "Member removed"), disappears after 5 seconds, and is announced by screen readers.
549	2. Given I press Save, then the button shows "Saving…" and is disabled until the save finishes.
550	3. Given I double-click Save, then only one bill is created.
551	4. Given a page is loading its data, then grey placeholder shapes are shown until the content appears.
552	5. Given I have no groups, then the Groups page shows "No groups yet. Create one to start splitting with friends." with a Create group button. Empty solo-bill, group-bill and activity lists likewise explain what to do next.
553	6. Given I press Delete, Remove member, Leave or close out a group, then a pop-up asks me to confirm. The dangerous button is red, and Cancel or Stay is the safe default.
554	
555	### US-38 Don't lose unsaved changes by accident
556	**As a** Solo diner or Group member, **I want** a warning before I leave a bill I haven't saved, **so that** I don't lose a long receipt I've typed in.
557	- **Job:** J14 · **Status:** Not implemented
558	
559	Acceptance criteria:
560	1. Given I've changed a bill form without saving, when I click a sidebar link, the back button or any other link, then I'm asked "You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?" with Stay and Leave.
561	2. Given that question, when I press Stay, then I stay on the form with everything I typed.
562	3. Given that question, when I press Leave, then I go to the other page and the changes are discarded. Nothing is saved as a draft.
563	4. Given I've changed a bill form without saving, when I close or reload the browser tab, then the browser's own "Leave site?" prompt appears.
564	5. Given I haven't changed anything, or I've just saved, when I leave the form, then no warning appears.
565	
566	---
567	
568	## Running the app
569	
570	### US-30 Run the app locally from the README
571	**As a** Host, **I want** to install and start the app on my computer by following the README, **so that** I can try it for free.
572	- **Job:** J17 · **Status:** Not implemented
573	
574	Acceptance criteria:
575	1. Given Node.js LTS and Docker are installed, when I follow the README steps on a fresh clone (copy `.env.example` to `.env`, `docker compose up -d`, `npm install`, `npm run dev`, open the shown address), then the app runs and I can sign up locally.
576	2. Given the README, then it never asks for a paid account, an API key, or any third-party cloud or paid service.
577	3. Given the app is running, then it works with no internet-based service: accounts, data storage and calculations all happen inside the app and its own self-hosted PostgreSQL container.
578	4. Given the database container isn't running, when I start the app, then it prints "Can't reach the database. Start it with: docker compose up -d" and stops, with no crash trace.
579	5. Given a fresh database, when the app starts, then it creates its own tables automatically. No manual database setup is needed.
580	6. Given the database container is running, then its port is reachable only from my own computer, not from other machines on the network.
581	7. Given the README, then it warns that `docker compose down -v` permanently deletes all saved data, and that plain `docker compose down` keeps it.
582	
583	### US-31 Deploy the app to my own server
584	**As a** Host, **I want** to run the same app on a server, **so that** my friends can use it for real.
585	- **Job:** J18 · **Status:** Not implemented
586	
587	Acceptance criteria:
588	1. Given a server with Node.js LTS and a self-hosted PostgreSQL 18 database (e.g. the same Compose file), when I deploy the same build, then it runs, configured only through settings the app owns: port, `DATABASE_URL` and session secret.
589	2. Given the deployed app, then it doesn't depend on any third-party cloud or paid service.
590	3. Given the deployed app, then passwords are stored hashed (never as plain text), and sessions use secure cookies.
591	4. Given the deployed app starts against a database that already has data, then pending schema updates are applied automatically and existing data is kept.
592	
593	### US-32 Run all tests with one command
594	**As a** Host, **I want** to run every automated test with one command, **so that** I can see for myself that the app works as described.
595	- **Job:** J19 · **Status:** Not implemented
596	
597	Acceptance criteria:
598	1. Given the project is installed and the database container is running, when I run `npm test`, then the calculation, validation and server tests and the browser tests (Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, Safari's engine) all run and pass.
599	2. Given I have real bills saved in the app, when I run `npm test`, then the tests use only the separate test database, which is wiped and rebuilt at the start of each run, and my real data is unchanged.
600	3. Given I run `npm test` twice in a row, then both runs give the same results.
601	4. Given the database container isn't running, when I run `npm test`, then it stops at once with "Can't reach the database. Start it with: docker compose up -d".
602	
603	---
604	
605	## Open questions
606	
607	None. Every open question has been settled in the spec and is reflected in the stories above.
608

483 .omc/specs/deep-interview-bill-splitter.md
# Deep Interview Spec: Bill Splitting Calculator (v2)

## Metadata
- Interview ID: b7e2c1a4-5d3f-4e8a-9c21-bill-splitter-01
- Rounds: 19 (plus Round 0 topology check)
- Final Ambiguity Score: 17.6%
- Type: greenfield
- Generated: 2026-10-21 (v2 replaces the v1 spec written after Round 10; v2.1 adds the Other charges field; v2.2 settles payer, settle-up, invite code and member-removal rules; v2.3 adds group deletion by the last account holder and rejoining with the invite code; v2.4 settles the 11 gaps found while writing the docs; v2.5 replaces SQLite with self-hosted PostgreSQL; v2.6 adds the Frontend Design section)
- Threshold: 0.2
- Threshold Source: default
- Initial Context Summarized: no
- Status: PASSED — pending approval

## Clarity Breakdown
| Dimension | Score | Weight | Weighted |
|-----------|-------|--------|----------|
| Goal Clarity | 0.86 | 0.40 | 0.344 |
| Constraint Clarity | 0.84 | 0.30 | 0.252 |
| Success Criteria | 0.76 | 0.30 | 0.228 |
| **Total Clarity** | | | **0.824** |
| **Ambiguity** | | | **0.176** |

## Topology
| Component | Status | Description | Coverage |
|-----------|--------|-------------|----------|
| Solo bill | active | A logged-in person totals their own bill (items, tax, other charges, tip) and keeps a private history | AC-S, AC-H |
| Equal group split | active | A group bill (items, tax, other charges, tip) split evenly between the members who took part, cent-exact | AC-E |
| Itemized group split | active | Each participant pays for what they had (items can be shared) plus proportional tax, other charges and tip | AC-I |
| Groups (added R13) | active | Lasting friend groups: name-only or claimed members, payer, running balances, settle-ups, activity log | AC-G |
| Accounts (added R14) | active | In-app username/password accounts with a recovery code; no outside services | AC-A |
| Tech choices and setup | active | TypeScript, React, Node.js/Express, self-hosted PostgreSQL (Docker Compose); runs locally from the README and deploys to any server | AC-T |
| Product docs | active | Roles, jobs and stories in the saved format, kept in line with the app | AC-D |

## Goal
A self-contained web app for splitting and tracking bills:
- **Solo diners** total their own bills (items, tax, other charges and tip) and keep a private history.
- **Friends** form lasting groups. Any member can record a group bill: who paid, who took part, and whether it's split equally or by items. The app keeps exact running balances, shows the fewest payments needed to settle up, and records settle-ups.

All money math is exact to the cent, and every invalid input gives a clear message, never a crash or a wrong result.

## Constraints
- **Browsers:** current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari.
- **No third-party services:** the app must not depend on any external cloud or paid service (no hosted auth, hosted database, email/SMS or payment APIs). It **can** be deployed to a server. Reviewers must be able to run it locally from the README with only free software: **Node.js LTS and Docker** (Docker Desktop is free for personal use; Docker Engine on Linux and Podman with Compose are free alternatives). A self-hosted PostgreSQL container counts as part of the app, not a third-party service.
- **Accounts:** built into the app. Username + password, with passwords hashed. Sessions use secure cookies. No email anywhere.
  - **Username:** 3–30 characters; letters, numbers and underscore only. Not case-sensitive: "Sana" and "sana" are the same account, so the second is "taken".
  - **Password:** 8–128 characters, any characters including spaces.
  - **Sessions:** a **Log out** button ends the session at once. Otherwise a session ends after **30 days without use**, and the user must log in again.
  - **No limit on failed login or recovery-code attempts** (user's choice).
- **Storage:** a **self-hosted PostgreSQL** database (official `postgres` image, pinned to major version 18), started from a `docker-compose.yml` in the repo.
  - **Data persistence:** data lives in a named Docker volume, so it survives app restarts, container restarts and `docker compose down`. Only `docker compose down -v` deletes it, and the README warns about this.
  - **Network:** Postgres's port is published on 127.0.0.1 only, so other machines on the network can't reach it.
  - **Connection:** the app connects through one setting, `DATABASE_URL`. Local development values (user, password, database name) are in a committed `.env.example`, are copied to a git-ignored `.env`, and are for local use only, never production.
  - **Two databases in the same container:** `bill_splitter` for the app and `bill_splitter_test` for automated tests. Both are created automatically the first time the container starts.
  - **Schema:** created and updated by migration scripts that run automatically when the app server starts.
  - **All-or-nothing saves:** every save (a bill with its items and shares, a settle-up, a member change and its activity log entry) is one database transaction. A failure never leaves anything half-saved.
  - **Database not running:** the app server refuses to start and prints "Can't reach the database. Start it with: docker compose up -d", with no crash trace. If the database stops while the app is running, saves show a clear message, inputs are kept, and nothing is half-saved.
- **Local run (README):** copy `.env.example` to `.env`, run `docker compose up -d`, then `npm install` and `npm run dev`, and open the shown local address.
- **Modes:** Solo (personal), Group bill with Equal split, and Group bill with Itemized split. These are separate screens and rules (Round 4).
- **Number limits:**
  - Money: 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places. No negatives, letters, blanks or extra decimals.
  - **The 1,000,000.00 limit is per field** (each item price, tax amount, tip amount, other-charges amount, settle-up). The food subtotal and grand total **may be larger**.
  - **Items per bill:** 1–200. Adding a 201st shows "A bill can have at most 200 items".
  - The largest possible bill is 200 items × 1,000,000.00, with tax 100%, other charges 100% and tip 100% on food + tax: food 200,000,000.00 + tax 200,000,000.00 + other charges 200,000,000.00 + tip 400,000,000.00 = grand total **1,000,000,000.00**, which must still be exact to the cent.
  - Group size: 1–50 **current** members. A group starts with just its creator, and removed members don't count toward the 50.
  - Tax and tip %: 0–100, at most 2 decimal places (e.g. 12.5 or 8.25). Tax and tip amounts: 0.00–1,000,000.00.
  - Other charges (optional): blank, 0 or 0.00 means "no other charges". Otherwise:
    - as an amount: 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places
    - as a %: 0.01–100, at most 2 decimal places
    - negatives, letters and extra decimals are rejected.
- **Bill fields:** every bill (solo and both group modes) has the same four money parts: items, tax, **other charges** and tip. Other charges is a single field per bill, always labelled "Other charges" (for service, delivery or table fees and similar), with a % / amount switch like tax and tip.
- **Names** (spaces at the start and end are trimmed before checking):
  - **Group name:** required, 1–50 characters.
  - **Member name:** required, 1–30 characters, and **never reused within a group**. A name can't match any member the group has ever had, current or removed. Not case-sensitive: "omar" clashes with "Omar". The message is "That name has already been used in this group". (A name is only freed if the whole group is deleted.)
  - **Bill name** (solo and group): optional, up to 60 characters. Defaults to "Bill – date".
  - **Item name:** optional, up to 40 characters. Defaults to "Item 1", "Item 2" and so on, by position.
- **Currency:** a display symbol only, with no conversion. Choose from a default list of 12: $, €, £, ¥, ₹, Rs, ₩, ₺, R$, CHF, AED, SAR. Or choose **"Other"** and type a custom symbol of **1–3 characters with no digits**. Spaces at the start and end are trimmed. A blank symbol, a symbol of 4+ characters, or one containing a digit shows "Currency symbol must be 1–3 characters with no digits".
  - Each **group** has one currency, chosen at creation and never changeable. A note says so when you choose it.
  - Each **solo bill** has its own currency, locked when the bill is first saved.
- **Math:** integer cents only, never floating-point money.
- **Results:** totals appear when the user presses **Calculate**. Changing any input hides the old result until Calculate is pressed again.

## Non-Goals
- Currency conversion; multiple currencies in one group.
- Email or SMS (invites, password resets, notifications).
- Real payment processing (settle-ups are records only).
- Receipt scanning, native mobile apps, real-time push updates.
- Multiple payers on one bill (Round 19).
- Regenerating or changing a group's invite code.
- A quick split without a group: splitting a bill between people always happens inside a group, even for a one-off outing.
- Permanently deleting a member, or erasing their part of past bills.
- More than one other-charges line per bill, or custom labels for it.
- Tax on other charges, or tip on other charges.
- Limiting or pausing repeated failed login or recovery-code attempts.

## Calculation Rules
1. **Tax:** a % (of the food subtotal) or an amount. Tax is never charged on other charges or tip.
2. **Other charges:** optional; a % or an amount. A % is a percentage of the **food subtotal only** (the same base as tax), never of tax or tip. Blank or 0 means 0.00 other charges, and the results still show an "Other charges 0.00" line.
3. **Tip:** a % or an amount. Tip may be 0. For a % tip, each bill has a "tip on" option: **food only (default)** or **food + tax**. Neither option includes other charges: a tip is never calculated on other charges.
4. **Rounding and order:** tax, other charges and tip are each worked out separately, in cents. Any % result is rounded half-up to the cent, so it can be 0.00 (e.g. 5% of 0.01). A "food + tax" tip uses the already-rounded tax.
5. **Grand total** = food subtotal + tax + other charges + tip.
6. **Equal split:** grand total (including other charges) ÷ number of participants. Leftover cents go 1 each to the first participants in list order, and the app shows who pays the extra cent.
7. **Itemized split:**
   - Each item has a price and 1+ ticked participants. Its cost is split evenly between them, with leftover cents going to the first ticked people.
   - Tax, other charges and tip are each split separately in proportion to each participant's food subtotal. Leftover cents are assigned by largest remainder, and ties go to the first participant in list order.
   - A participant with no items owes 0.00 (including 0.00 tax, other charges and tip).
8. **Group balances:**
   - Each group bill has one payer, and **the payer must be one of that bill's participants**. The payer list only offers ticked participants. If the payer is unticked, Calculate and Save show "The payer must be one of the people on this bill".
   - The payer is credited with the full grand total, and each participant (including the payer) is debited their share. So the payer's net change is grand total − their own share.
   - A settle-up from A to B (A pays B) credits A and debits B. A and B must be two different current members. The amount can be any valid amount (0.01–1,000,000.00, 2 decimals), **even more than A owes B**. The balances simply update, and an overpayment flips the direction of the debt.
   - Net balances across the group always sum to exactly 0.00.
9. **Invite code:**
   - Each group gets one invite code, generated automatically when the group is created. It never changes, and there is no regenerate option.
   - Any current member can view it and copy it with a Copy button.
   - Entering the code (while logged in) does one of the following:
     - **Removed member with this account:** they are **restored automatically** with their full history (the same as Restore). The log says "Omar rejoined with the invite code".
     - **New account:** they choose a name to claim from the group's **unclaimed** members, current or removed. Removed names are marked "(removed)", and claiming one restores it.
     - **Already a current member:** "You're already in this group", and nothing changes.
   - The code can't create a brand-new member. New names are added by a current member.
   - The restore limit below (50 current members) applies to rejoining with the code too.
10. **Removing, leaving and restoring members:**
   - **Settled ≠ removed.** A member with balance 0.00 is still a normal member. "Removed" means taken off the group's current member list.
   - Any member can remove another member, and any member can leave (remove themselves), but **only when that member's balance is exactly 0.00**. The one exception is the last member with an account, below.
   - **Last member with an account leaving:** when the only current member with an account presses Leave, the app warns: "You're the last member with an account. If you leave, this group and all its bills, settle-ups and history will be permanently deleted. Unsettled balances will be lost."
     - **Cancel:** nothing changes.
     - **Leave:** the whole group is permanently deleted, including its members, bills, settle-ups, activity log and invite code. Their balance doesn't need to be 0.00 first.
     - This only happens through leaving. Anyone else removing them would themselves have to be a current member with an account, so they could never be the last one.
   - Leaving or deleting never touches anyone's account or solo bills.
   - There is no separate "delete group" button.
   - Removing never changes past data. Old bills and settle-ups keep the member, shown as "Name (removed)", and every total and balance stays exactly the same.
   - A removed member can't be chosen as payer, participant or settle-up person on new bills or settle-ups. They don't appear in the balance list or the settle-up suggestions.
   - While a member is removed, any bill or settle-up that includes them is **view-only**: it can't be edited or deleted, because that would change a removed member's balance. The message is "Restore Omar to change this bill".
   - If the removed member had an account, they **lose access** to the group right away: it disappears from their group list, and its pages are refused even by typing the address directly. Their account and solo bills are untouched, and the link between their account and the member is kept.
   - The group's members page lists removed members under "Removed members", each with a **Restore** button that any current member can use. Restoring brings back the same member, with one continuous history and the "(removed)" mark gone. If they had an account, their access returns.
   - Restoring is refused with a clear message if the group already has 50 current members. (A name clash can't happen, because names are never reused within a group.)
   - While a member is removed, bills that include them are view-only. **Once they're restored (by Restore or the invite code), those bills and settle-ups can be edited and deleted again.**
   - The activity log records **every change to the group**, each with who, when and what changed:
     - "X created the group"
     - "X added Omar"
     - "Omar claimed the name Omar"
     - bills and settle-ups added, edited or deleted
     - "X removed Omar", "Omar left", "X restored Omar" and "Omar rejoined with the invite code"
11. **Settle-up suggestions:** the fewest payments that bring every net balance to zero (greedy match of largest debtor to largest creditor), shown as "X pays Y amount".
12. **Invariant:** for every bill, the shares sum exactly to the grand total. In itemized bills, the per-person tax, other-charges and tip parts also each sum exactly to the bill's tax, other charges and tip.

## Frontend Design (v2.6)

Decided in the frontend interview (11 rounds, final ambiguity 18.4%).

### Devices and layout
- **Desktop-first:** designed for a computer screen first, then adapted to phones. It must still be fully usable on a phone, at widths down to 360 px, with no sideways scrolling of the page.
- **Navigation:** a **left sidebar** with Dashboard, Solo bills, Groups and Account is always visible on wide screens. On narrow screens (phones) it folds into a menu button at the top.

### Screens
- **Dashboard (first screen after login):**
  - A money summary: "You owe" and "You're owed", one line **per currency**, because groups can use different currencies and amounts are never added across currencies.
  - Your groups, each with your balance in that group.
  - Your latest solo bills.
  - Quick buttons: "New solo bill" and "New group bill".
- **Bill form** (solo, equal split, itemized split):
  - Items are entered as rows.
  - Tax, other charges and tip each have a % / amount switch next to the field.
  - The "tip on" option (food only / food + tax) appears only when the tip is a %.
  - **Itemized bills:** each item row has a **multi-select dropdown** listing the bill's participants with tick boxes. When closed, it shows the chosen names (e.g. "Ali, Sara, Omar"). An empty selection shows "Choose who shared this item".
  - **Payer:** chosen from a dropdown that lists only ticked participants.
- **Results:** shown **below the form** on every screen size.
  - After Calculate, the page scrolls down to them.
  - They list subtotal, tax, other charges, tip and total, then (for group bills) each person's share, with "+1 cent" marked on people who pay an extra cent.
  - Before the first Calculate, the area reads "Press Calculate to see results".
  - Changing any input hides the result again.
- **Group page (balances first):**
  - Top: each member's balance (e.g. "+13.00 is owed", "−13.00 owes") and the suggested payments. Each suggestion has a **"Record this payment"** button that opens the settle-up form pre-filled with that payer, receiver and amount, for the user to confirm or adjust.
  - An "Add bill" button is always visible at the top.
  - Tabs below: **Bills · Settle-ups · Members · Activity**. The invite code (with Copy) and Removed members (with Restore) are on the Members tab.
- **Account page:** shows the username, the appearance setting and the Log out button. Password reset with the recovery code happens from the login page, as before.

### Look and feel
- **Clean and calm:** lots of white space, a soft grey page background, white rounded cards, one accent color for buttons, links and highlights, and clear readable fonts.
- **Money colors:** amounts you owe are red, and amounts owed to you are green. Colour is never the only signal: "+" / "−" and "owes" / "is owed" are always shown too.
- **Appearance:** light or dark mode **follows the device** by default. A setting in Account (Device / Light / Dark) overrides it and is remembered for the account. Both themes meet the contrast rules below.

### Numbers and language
- All text is in **English**.
- Amounts are shown with a thousands comma and 2 decimals: "1,000,000.00".
- The currency symbol goes before the amount: "$12.50", "€12.50". Symbols made of letters get a space: "Rs 400.00", "CHF 12.00", "AED 5.00", and the same for custom symbols such as "kr 30.00".
- **Typing amounts:** "1000.50" and "1,000.50" are both accepted (commas are ignored). European style "1.000,50" and misplaced commas are rejected with the field's normal message.

### Feedback and states
- **Success messages:** a short message in the corner ("Bill saved", "Payment recorded", "Member removed") that disappears after 5 seconds and is announced to screen readers.
- **Saving:** the button shows "Saving…" and is disabled until the save finishes, so a double-click never saves twice.
- **Loading:** grey placeholder shapes while a page's data loads.
- **Empty screens:** a short explanation plus the next step, e.g. "No groups yet. Create one to start splitting with friends." [Create group]. The same applies to no solo bills, no group bills and no activity.
- **Confirmations:** deleting, removing a member, leaving and closing out a group use a pop-up dialog, with the dangerous button in red and Cancel/Stay as the safe default.
- **Unsaved changes:** leaving a bill form with unsaved changes (sidebar link, back button, other link) asks "You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?" [Stay] [Leave]. Closing or reloading the tab triggers the browser's own "Leave site?" prompt. No drafts are stored.

### Accessibility (best practice: WCAG 2.2 AA)
- **Keyboard:** everything works with the keyboard alone (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Esc, arrow keys in dropdowns), with a clearly visible focus outline. Dialogs keep focus inside and close with Esc.

| Goal Clarity | 0.86 | 0.40 | 0.344 |
| Constraint Clarity | 0.84 | 0.30 | 0.252 |

## Topology
| Component | Status | Description | Coverage |
|-----------|--------|-------------|----------|
| Solo bill | active | A logged-in person totals their own bill (items, tax, other charges, tip) and keeps a private history | AC-S, AC-H |
| Equal group split | active | A group bill (items, tax, other charges, tip) split evenly between the members who took part, cent-exact | AC-E |
| Itemized group split | active | Each participant pays for what they had (items can be shared) plus proportional tax, other charges and tip | AC-I |
| Groups (added R13) | active | Lasting friend groups: name-only or claimed members, payer, running balances, settle-ups, activity log | AC-G |
| Accounts (added R14) | active | In-app username/password accounts with a recovery code; no outside services | AC-A |
| Tech choices and setup | active | TypeScript, React, Node.js/Express, self-hosted PostgreSQL (Docker Compose); runs locally from the README and deploys to any server | AC-T |
| Product docs | active | Roles, jobs and stories in the saved format, kept in line with the app | AC-D |

## Goal
A self-contained web app for splitting and tracking bills:
- **Solo diners** total their own bills (items, tax, other charges and tip) and keep a private history.
- **Friends** form lasting groups. Any member can record a group bill: who paid, who took part, and whether it's split equally or by items. The app keeps exact running balances, shows the fewest payments needed to settle up, and records settle-ups.

All money math is exact to the cent, and every invalid input gives a clear message, never a crash or a wrong result.

## Constraints
- **Browsers:** current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari.
- **No third-party services:** the app must not depend on any external cloud or paid service (no hosted auth, hosted database, email/SMS or payment APIs). It **can** be deployed to a server. Reviewers must be able to run it locally from the README with only free software: **Node.js LTS and Docker** (Docker Desktop is free for personal use; Docker Engine on Linux and Podman with Compose are free alternatives). A self-hosted PostgreSQL container counts as part of the app, not a third-party service.
- **Accounts:** built into the app. Username + password, with passwords hashed. Sessions use secure cookies. No email anywhere.
  - **Username:** 3–30 characters; letters, numbers and underscore only. Not case-sensitive: "Sana" and "sana" are the same account, so the second is "taken".
  - **Password:** 8–128 characters, any characters including spaces.
  - **Sessions:** a **Log out** button ends the session at once. Otherwise a session ends after **30 days without use**, and the user must log in again.
  - **No limit on failed login or recovery-code attempts** (user's choice).
- **Storage:** a **self-hosted PostgreSQL** database (official `postgres` image, pinned to major version 18), started from a `docker-compose.yml` in the repo.
  - **Data persistence:** data lives in a named Docker volume, so it survives app restarts, container restarts and `docker compose down`. Only `docker compose down -v` deletes it, and the README warns about this.
  - **Network:** Postgres's port is published on 127.0.0.1 only, so other machines on the network can't reach it.
  - **Connection:** the app connects through one setting, `DATABASE_URL`. Local development values (user, password, database name) are in a committed `.env.example`, are copied to a git-ignored `.env`, and are for local use only, never production.
  - **Two databases in the same container:** `bill_splitter` for the app and `bill_splitter_test` for automated tests. Both are created automatically the first time the container starts.
  - **Schema:** created and updated by migration scripts that run automatically when the app server starts.
  - **All-or-nothing saves:** every save (a bill with its items and shares, a settle-up, a member change and its activity log entry) is one database transaction. A failure never leaves anything half-saved.
  - **Database not running:** the app server refuses to start and prints "Can't reach the database. Start it with: docker compose up -d", with no crash trace. If the database stops while the app is running, saves show a clear message, inputs are kept, and nothing is half-saved.
- **Local run (README):** copy `.env.example` to `.env`, run `docker compose up -d`, then `npm install` and `npm run dev`, and open the shown local address.
- **Modes:** Solo (personal), Group bill with Equal split, and Group bill with Itemized split. These are separate screens and rules (Round 4).
- **Number limits:**
  - Money: 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places. No negatives, letters, blanks or extra decimals.
  - **The 1,000,000.00 limit is per field** (each item price, tax amount, tip amount, other-charges amount, settle-up). The food subtotal and grand total **may be larger**.
  - **Items per bill:** 1–200. Adding a 201st shows "A bill can have at most 200 items".
  - The largest possible bill is 200 items × 1,000,000.00, with tax 100%, other charges 100% and tip 100% on food + tax: food 200,000,000.00 + tax 200,000,000.00 + other charges 200,000,000.00 + tip 400,000,000.00 = grand total **1,000,000,000.00**, which must still be exact to the cent.
  - Group size: 1–50 **current** members. A group starts with just its creator, and removed members don't count toward the 50.
  - Tax and tip %: 0–100, at most 2 decimal places (e.g. 12.5 or 8.25). Tax and tip amounts: 0.00–1,000,000.00.
  - Other charges (optional): blank, 0 or 0.00 means "no other charges". Otherwise:
    - as an amount: 0.01–1,000,000.00, at most 2 decimal places
    - as a %: 0.01–100, at most 2 decimal places
    - negatives, letters and extra decimals are rejected.
- **Bill fields:** every bill (solo and both group modes) has the same four money parts: items, tax, **other charges** and tip. Other charges is a single field per bill, always labelled "Other charges" (for service, delivery or table fees and similar), with a % / amount switch like tax and tip.
- **Names** (spaces at the start and end are trimmed before checking):
  - **Group name:** required, 1–50 characters.
  - **Member name:** required, 1–30 characters, and **never reused within a group**. A name can't match any member the group has ever had, current or removed. Not case-sensitive: "omar" clashes with "Omar". The message is "That name has already been used in this group". (A name is only freed if the whole group is deleted.)
  - **Bill name** (solo and group): optional, up to 60 characters. Defaults to "Bill – date".
  - **Item name:** optional, up to 40 characters. Defaults to "Item 1", "Item 2" and so on, by position.
- **Currency:** a display symbol only, with no conversion. Choose from a default list of 12: $, €, £, ¥, ₹, Rs, ₩, ₺, R$, CHF, AED, SAR. Or choose **"Other"** and type a custom symbol of **1–3 characters with no digits**. Spaces at the start and end are trimmed. A blank symbol, a symbol of 4+ characters, or one containing a digit shows "Currency symbol must be 1–3 characters with no digits".
  - Each **group** has one currency, chosen at creation and never changeable. A note says so when you choose it.
  - Each **solo bill** has its own currency, locked when the bill is first saved.
- **Math:** integer cents only, never floating-point money.
- **Results:** totals appear when the user presses **Calculate**. Changing any input hides the old result until Calculate is pressed again.

## Non-Goals
- Currency conversion; multiple currencies in one group.
- Email or SMS (invites, password resets, notifications).
- Real payment processing (settle-ups are records only).
- Receipt scanning, native mobile apps, real-time push updates.
- Multiple payers on one bill (Round 19).
- Regenerating or changing a group's invite code.
- A quick split without a group: splitting a bill between people always happens inside a group, even for a one-off outing.
- Permanently deleting a member, or erasing their part of past bills.
- More than one other-charges line per bill, or custom labels for it.
- Tax on other charges, or tip on other charges.
- Limiting or pausing repeated failed login or recovery-code attempts.

## Calculation Rules
1. **Tax:** a % (of the food subtotal) or an amount. Tax is never charged on other charges or tip.
2. **Other charges:** optional; a % or an amount. A % is a percentage of the **food subtotal only** (the same base as tax), never of tax or tip. Blank or 0 means 0.00 other charges, and the results still show an "Other charges 0.00" line.
3. **Tip:** a % or an amount. Tip may be 0. For a % tip, each bill has a "tip on" option: **food only (default)** or **food + tax**. Neither option includes other charges: a tip is never calculated on other charges.
4. **Rounding and order:** tax, other charges and tip are each worked out separately, in cents. Any % result is rounded half-up to the cent, so it can be 0.00 (e.g. 5% of 0.01). A "food + tax" tip uses the already-rounded tax.
5. **Grand total** = food subtotal + tax + other charges + tip.
6. **Equal split:** grand total (including other charges) ÷ number of participants. Leftover cents go 1 each to the first participants in list order, and the app shows who pays the extra cent.
7. **Itemized split:**
   - Each item has a price and 1+ ticked participants. Its cost is split evenly between them, with leftover cents going to the first ticked people.
   - Tax, other charges and tip are each split separately in proportion to each participant's food subtotal. Leftover cents are assigned by largest remainder, and ties go to the first participant in list order.
   - A participant with no items owes 0.00 (including 0.00 tax, other charges and tip).
8. **Group balances:**
   - Each group bill has one payer, and **the payer must be one of that bill's participants**. The payer list only offers ticked participants. If the payer is unticked, Calculate and Save show "The payer must be one of the people on this bill".
   - The payer is credited with the full grand total, and each participant (including the payer) is debited their share. So the payer's net change is grand total − their own share.
   - A settle-up from A to B (A pays B) credits A and debits B. A and B must be two different current members. The amount can be any valid amount (0.01–1,000,000.00, 2 decimals), **even more than A owes B**. The balances simply update, and an overpayment flips the direction of the debt.
   - Net balances across the group always sum to exactly 0.00.
9. **Invite code:**
   - Each group gets one invite code, generated automatically when the group is created. It never changes, and there is no regenerate option.
   - Any current member can view it and copy it with a Copy button.
   - Entering the code (while logged in) does one of the following:
     - **Removed member with this account:** they are **restored automatically** with their full history (the same as Restore). The log says "Omar rejoined with the invite code".
     - **New account:** they choose a name to claim from the group's **unclaimed** members, current or removed. Removed names are marked "(removed)", and claiming one restores it.
     - **Already a current member:** "You're already in this group", and nothing changes.
   - The code can't create a brand-new member. New names are added by a current member.
   - The restore limit below (50 current members) applies to rejoining with the code too.
10. **Removing, leaving and restoring members:**
   - **Settled ≠ removed.** A member with balance 0.00 is still a normal member. "Removed" means taken off the group's current member list.
   - Any member can remove another member, and any member can leave (remove themselves), but **only when that member's balance is exactly 0.00**. The one exception is the last member with an account, below.
   - **Last member with an account leaving:** when the only current member with an account presses Leave, the app warns: "You're the last member with an account. If you leave, this group and all its bills, settle-ups and history will be permanently deleted. Unsettled balances will be lost."
     - **Cancel:** nothing changes.
     - **Leave:** the whole group is permanently deleted, including its members, bills, settle-ups, activity log and invite code. Their balance doesn't need to be 0.00 first.
     - This only happens through leaving. Anyone else removing them would themselves have to be a current member with an account, so they could never be the last one.
   - Leaving or deleting never touches anyone's account or solo bills.
   - There is no separate "delete group" button.
   - Removing never changes past data. Old bills and settle-ups keep the member, shown as "Name (removed)", and every total and balance stays exactly the same.
   - A removed member can't be chosen as payer, participant or settle-up person on new bills or settle-ups. They don't appear in the balance list or the settle-up suggestions.
   - While a member is removed, any bill or settle-up that includes them is **view-only**: it can't be edited or deleted, because that would change a removed member's balance. The message is "Restore Omar to change this bill".
   - If the removed member had an account, they **lose access** to the group right away: it disappears from their group list, and its pages are refused even by typing the address directly. Their account and solo bills are untouched, and the link between their account and the member is kept.
   - The group's members page lists removed members under "Removed members", each with a **Restore** button that any current member can use. Restoring brings back the same member, with one continuous history and the "(removed)" mark gone. If they had an account, their access returns.
   - Restoring is refused with a clear message if the group already has 50 current members. (A name clash can't happen, because names are never reused within a group.)
   - While a member is removed, bills that include them are view-only. **Once they're restored (by Restore or the invite code), those bills and settle-ups can be edited and deleted again.**
   - The activity log records **every change to the group**, each with who, when and what changed:
     - "X created the group"
     - "X added Omar"
     - "Omar claimed the name Omar"
     - bills and settle-ups added, edited or deleted
     - "X removed Omar", "Omar left", "X restored Omar" and "Omar rejoined with the invite code"
11. **Settle-up suggestions:** the fewest payments that bring every net balance to zero (greedy match of largest debtor to largest creditor), shown as "X pays Y amount".
12. **Invariant:** for every bill, the shares sum exactly to the grand total. In itemized bills, the per-person tax, other-charges and tip parts also each sum exactly to the bill's tax, other charges and tip.

## Frontend Design (v2.6)

Decided in the frontend interview (11 rounds, final ambiguity 18.4%).

### Devices and layout
- **Desktop-first:** designed for a computer screen first, then adapted to phones. It must still be fully usable on a phone, at widths down to 360 px, with no sideways scrolling of the page.
- **Navigation:** a **left sidebar** with Dashboard, Solo bills, Groups and Account is always visible on wide screens. On narrow screens (phones) it folds into a menu button at the top.

### Screens
- **Dashboard (first screen after login):**
  - A money summary: "You owe" and "You're owed", one line **per currency**, because groups can use different currencies and amounts are never added across currencies.
  - Your groups, each with your balance in that group.
  - Your latest solo bills.
  - Quick buttons: "New solo bill" and "New group bill".
- **Bill form** (solo, equal split, itemized split):
  - Items are entered as rows.
  - Tax, other charges and tip each have a % / amount switch next to the field.
  - The "tip on" option (food only / food + tax) appears only when the tip is a %.
  - **Itemized bills:** each item row has a **multi-select dropdown** listing the bill's participants with tick boxes. When closed, it shows the chosen names (e.g. "Ali, Sara, Omar"). An empty selection shows "Choose who shared this item".
  - **Payer:** chosen from a dropdown that lists only ticked participants.
- **Results:** shown **below the form** on every screen size.
  - After Calculate, the page scrolls down to them.
  - They list subtotal, tax, other charges, tip and total, then (for group bills) each person's share, with "+1 cent" marked on people who pay an extra cent.
  - Before the first Calculate, the area reads "Press Calculate to see results".
  - Changing any input hides the result again.
- **Group page (balances first):**
  - Top: each member's balance (e.g. "+13.00 is owed", "−13.00 owes") and the suggested payments. Each suggestion has a **"Record this payment"** button that opens the settle-up form pre-filled with that payer, receiver and amount, for the user to confirm or adjust.
  - An "Add bill" button is always visible at the top.
  - Tabs below: **Bills · Settle-ups · Members · Activity**. The invite code (with Copy) and Removed members (with Restore) are on the Members tab.
- **Account page:** shows the username, the appearance setting and the Log out button. Password reset with the recovery code happens from the login page, as before.

### Look and feel
- **Clean and calm:** lots of white space, a soft grey page background, white rounded cards, one accent color for buttons, links and highlights, and clear readable fonts.
- **Money colors:** amounts you owe are red, and amounts owed to you are green. Colour is never the only signal: "+" / "−" and "owes" / "is owed" are always shown too.
- **Appearance:** light or dark mode **follows the device** by default. A setting in Account (Device / Light / Dark) overrides it and is remembered for the account. Both themes meet the contrast rules below.

### Numbers and language
- All text is in **English**.
- Amounts are shown with a thousands comma and 2 decimals: "1,000,000.00".
- The currency symbol goes before the amount: "$12.50", "€12.50". Symbols made of letters get a space: "Rs 400.00", "CHF 12.00", "AED 5.00", and the same for custom symbols such as "kr 30.00".
- **Typing amounts:** "1000.50" and "1,000.50" are both accepted (commas are ignored). European style "1.000,50" and misplaced commas are rejected with the field's normal message.

### Feedback and states
- **Success messages:** a short message in the corner ("Bill saved", "Payment recorded", "Member removed") that disappears after 5 seconds and is announced to screen readers.
- **Saving:** the button shows "Saving…" and is disabled until the save finishes, so a double-click never saves twice.
- **Loading:** grey placeholder shapes while a page's data loads.
- **Empty screens:** a short explanation plus the next step, e.g. "No groups yet. Create one to start splitting with friends." [Create group]. The same applies to no solo bills, no group bills and no activity.
- **Confirmations:** deleting, removing a member, leaving and closing out a group use a pop-up dialog, with the dangerous button in red and Cancel/Stay as the safe default.
- **Unsaved changes:** leaving a bill form with unsaved changes (sidebar link, back button, other link) asks "You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?" [Stay] [Leave]. Closing or reloading the tab triggers the browser's own "Leave site?" prompt. No drafts are stored.

### Accessibility (best practice: WCAG 2.2 AA)
- **Keyboard:** everything works with the keyboard alone (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Esc, arrow keys in dropdowns), with a clearly visible focus outline. Dialogs keep focus inside and close with Esc.
- **Contrast:** at least 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for controls and focus outlines, in both light and dark mode.
- **Screen readers:** every field has a visible label. Errors are linked to their field and announced. Results and success messages are announced.
- **Zoom:** usable at 200% browser zoom.
- **Touch targets:** at least 24×24 px.
- **Testing:** automated accessibility checks (axe) run as part of `npm test` and must report no violations.

## Acceptance Criteria
### Frontend (AC-F)
- [ ] Given a screen 1280 px wide, then the sidebar is always visible. Given a screen 375 px wide, then it's replaced by a menu button, and every page fits with no sideways page scrolling.
- [ ] Given I log in, then I land on the Dashboard, showing per-currency "You owe" / "You're owed" lines, my groups with my balance in each, my latest solo bills, and "New solo bill" / "New group bill" buttons.
- [ ] Given I'm in groups using $ and Rs, then the Dashboard shows separate totals for $ and Rs, never one combined number.
- [ ] Given an itemized bill, when I open an item's people dropdown, then it lists only the bill's participants with tick boxes. When closed, it shows the ticked names.
- [ ] Given I press Calculate with valid inputs, then the results appear below the form and the page scrolls to them. Given I change any input, then the results area goes back to "Press Calculate to see results".
- [ ] Given I open a group, then balances and suggested payments are at the top, followed by the tabs Bills, Settle-ups, Members and Activity.
- [ ] Given I press "Record this payment" on "Sara pays Ali 13.00", then the settle-up form opens pre-filled with Sara → Ali, 13.00, and nothing is saved until I confirm.
- [ ] Given my device is in dark mode and the appearance setting is "Device", then the app is dark. Given I choose "Light", then it stays light after logging out and back in.
- [ ] Given amounts of 1234567.5 and 400 in Rs, then they're shown as "1,234,567.50" and "Rs 400.00".
- [ ] Given I type "1,000.50" in a money field, then it's accepted as 1000.50. Given I type "1.000,50", then the field's normal message is shown.
- [ ] Given I save a bill, then the Save button shows "Saving…" and is disabled until the save finishes, a "Bill saved" message appears and disappears after 5 seconds, and double-clicking Save creates only one bill.
- [ ] Given I have no groups, then the Groups page shows "No groups yet. Create one to start splitting with friends." with a Create group button.
- [ ] Given I've changed a bill form without saving, when I click a sidebar link, then I'm asked "You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?". Stay keeps everything, and Leave discards the changes.
- [ ] Given I use only the keyboard, then I can sign up, create a group, add a bill, calculate, save and record a settle-up, with a visible focus outline at every step.
- [ ] Given any page in light or dark mode, then automated accessibility checks report no WCAG 2.2 AA violations, and text contrast is at least 4.5:1.
- [ ] Given 200% browser zoom, then every page is still usable with no lost content or functions.

### Accounts (AC-A)
- [ ] Given a new username and a valid password, when I sign up, then my account is created, a one-time recovery code is shown with a "save this now" warning, and I'm logged in.
- [ ] Given a username that is already taken, when I sign up, then I see "That username is taken" and no account is created.
- [ ] Given a wrong password, when I log in, then I see "Username or password is incorrect" (without saying which one) and I stay logged out.
- [ ] Given my username + recovery code + a new password, when I reset, then I can log in with the new password, the old code stops working, and a new code is shown.
- [ ] Given I'm logged out, when I open any bill or group page, then I'm sent to login and no data is shown.
- [ ] Given I'm logged in, I can never see or change another account's solo bills, or groups I'm not a member of, even by typing the address directly.
- [ ] Given a username of 2 or 31 characters, or containing anything other than letters, numbers and underscore (e.g. "sana!" or "sa na"), when I sign up, then a clear message is shown and no account is created. Exactly 3 and exactly 30 characters are accepted.
- [ ] Given "Sana" already exists, when someone signs up as "sana", then they see "That username is taken". Logging in as "SANA" with Sana's password works.
- [ ] Given a password of 7 or 129 characters, when I sign up or reset, then a clear message is shown and nothing is saved. Exactly 8 and exactly 128 characters, including spaces and symbols, are accepted.
- [ ] Given I press Log out, then I'm logged out at once, and opening any bill or group page sends me to login.
- [ ] Given I haven't used the app for 30 days, when I return, then I must log in again. Using it within 30 days keeps me logged in.
- [ ] Given 20 wrong passwords in a row, when I then enter the correct one, then I'm logged in (no attempt limit).

### Solo (AC-S)
- [ ] Given items 12.50 and 7.50, tax 10%, other charges blank, tip 15% on food, when I press Calculate, then subtotal 20.00, tax 2.00, other charges 0.00, tip 3.00 and total 25.00 are shown.
- [ ] Given items 12.50 and 7.50, tax 10%, other charges 5%, tip 15% on food, when I press Calculate, then subtotal 20.00, tax 2.00, other charges 1.00, tip 3.00 and total 26.00 are shown.
- [ ] Given food 100.00, tax 10.00 (amount), other charges blank and tip 15% on food + tax, then the tip is 16.50 and the total is 126.50.
- [ ] Given food 100.00, tax 10.00 (amount), other charges 7.50 (amount) and tip 15% on food + tax, then other charges is 7.50, the tip is 16.50 (other charges are not tipped on) and the total is 134.00.
- [ ] Given food 100.00, tax 10% and other charges 10%, then other charges is 10.00 (a % of food only, not of food + tax).
- [ ] Given food 33.33 and other charges 12.5%, then other charges is 4.17 (4.16625 rounded half-up).
- [ ] Given other charges 0 or 0.00, then it is treated as "no other charges", shows 0.00, and causes no error.
- [ ] Given food 0.01, tax 0, other charges 1,000,000.00 (amount) and tip 0, then other charges is 1,000,000.00 and the total is 1,000,000.01.
- [ ] Given tip 0, then the tip shows 0.00 with no error.
- [ ] Given no items, when I press Calculate, then I see "Add at least one item" and no result.

### Equal group split (AC-E)
- [ ] Given total 100.00 with 3 participants, then the shares are 33.34 / 33.33 / 33.33, the first participant is marked as paying the extra cent, and the shares sum to 100.00.
- [ ] Given 0 participants selected, when I press Calculate, then I see "Choose who took part" and no result (no division by zero).
- [ ] Given 0.01 split between 2 participants, then the shares are 0.01 and 0.00.
- [ ] Given food 1,000,000.00, tax 0, other charges blank and a 100% tip on food, split between 50 participants, then the grand total is 2,000,000.00, each share is 40,000.00, and the shares sum to the total.
- [ ] Given food 1,000,000.00, tax 0, other charges 1,000,000.00 (amount) and tip 0, split between 3 participants, then the grand total is 2,000,000.00 and the shares are 666,666.67 / 666,666.67 / 666,666.66.
- [ ] Given food 90.00, tax 0, other charges 10% and tip 0, split between 3 participants, then other charges is 9.00, the grand total is 99.00, and each share is 33.00.
- [ ] Given food 10.00 and other charges 0.01 (amount), split between 2 participants, then the grand total is 10.01 and the shares are 5.01 and 5.00.

### Itemized group split (AC-I)
- [ ] Given Ali steak 40.00, Sara salad 10.00, tax 5.00, other charges blank and tip 10.00, then Ali's share is 52.00 and Sara's is 13.00.
- [ ] Given the same bill with other charges 2.50 (amount), then Ali pays 2.00 and Sara 0.50 of the other charges, Ali's share is 54.00, Sara's is 13.50, and they sum to the grand total of 67.50.
- [ ] Given three participants with 10.00 of food each and other charges 0.10, then their other-charges parts are 0.04 / 0.03 / 0.03 (the leftover cent goes to the first participant on a tie).
