BillsTab is not mounted, so the new bill is not shown, not marked "Saved" and not scrolled to. This breaks US-18 #2 ("I'm taken to the group's bill list with it marked Saved"). Before this change, and on the non-FROM_LIST path, saving lands on /groups/A, which shows the Bills tab. justSaved also stays set for 10 s, so the mark appears only if the person happens to open the Bills tab within that window.
  FIX: Make the group page open on the Bills tab when it is returned to after a save. For example, export a peek helper from hooks.ts (justSaved?.path === pathname and less than 10 s old). In a GroupPage mount effect, if it is true and tab !== 'bills', call setParams({}, { replace: true }) so BillsTab mounts and picks up the saved bill. A simpler but weaker option: pass state={tab === 'bills' ? FROM_LIST : undefined} on the header link. Saving from other tabs then takes the replace path, which reaches the Bills tab but leaves the group page twice in history.

[LOW] (navigation, 1/2) fromList survives a reload or tab discard, so navigate(-1) then does a full page load and loses the "Saved" mark, the scroll to the bill and the toast
  src/client/hooks.ts:102
  SCENARIO: Go from /solo to New solo bill (history.state.usr = {fromList:true}). Then reload, or on a phone switch apps so the browser discards and later restores the tab (Duplicate tab and session restore behave the same way). History state is kept, so fromList is still true. But the /solo entry belongs to the old document, so on Save history.go(-1) is a cross-document traversal: the whole app reloads at /solo. The module-level justSaved and the ToastProvider state are lost. The person gets no "Bill saved" toast (it shows for a moment before the unload), no "Saved" mark and no scroll, which breaks US-07 #1.
  FIX: Tie the flag to the current document. For example, `export const FROM_LIST = { fromList: performance.timeOrigin }`, and in useShowSavedBill go back only when `(location.state as {fromList?: number} | null)?.fromList === performance.timeOrigin`. Otherwise take the existing replace path, which keeps the toast and the "Saved" mark.

[LOW] (navigation, 2/2) If the person leaves mid-save, the save still finishes with navigate(-1) and moves them a second time (an empty editor, or out of the app)
  src/client/hooks.ts:104
  SCENARIO: New solo bill opened from the list, form filled in, Save clicked. While the POST is pending (slow network), the person clicks the header "Solo bills" link or presses browser Back. The unsaved-changes dialog appears; they choose Leave, and the editor unmounts. When the POST resolves, the save handler's stale closure (location.state.fromList is true) sets justSaved and calls navigate(-1). React-router's useNavigateStable never resets activeRef on unmount, so the call goes through. Via the link (history [/solo, /solo/new, /solo]) it goes back to /solo/new and opens an empty "New solo bill" form. Via browser Back it goes past the list to the Dashboard, or leaves the app if /solo was the first entry. The same applies to GroupBillPages.tsx:227. The old replace navigation also ran after unmount, but only replaced the current entry.
  FIX: In useShowSavedBill, keep a mounted ref (`const live = useRef(true); useEffect(() => { live.current = true; return () => { live.current = false; }; }, []);`) and return early if !live.current. Alternatively, skip when `window.history.state?.key !== location.key`.

[LOW] (form-css, 1/2) Holding Enter after a price adds a line, then the repeated keypress submits Calculate
  src/client/components/BillForm.tsx:207
  SCENARIO: The cursor is in the price of the last filled line, and the user holds Enter slightly past the key-repeat delay. This is common with slow-key or motor-impairment settings. The first keydown runs addItem(), and the effect moves focus to the new blank line's name box. The next auto-repeat keydown (e.repeat = true) lands in that box. It is the last line and isBlankItem is true, so line 207 returns before preventDefault and before the e.repeat guard on line 209. The browser then submits the form implicitly, Calculate runs, and revealResults (or focusFirstError) moves focus away from the line the user meant to type in. The e.repeat guard never covers the fall-through branch.
  FIX: Check repeats before the fall-through. Right after the Enter/IME guard, add `if (e.repeat) { e.preventDefault(); return; }`, and drop the later `if (e.repeat) return;`.

[LOW] (form-css, 1/2) Dialog title now wraps, but the same long name still overflows the dialog's confirm button
  src/client/pages/InvitePage.tsx:220
  SCENARIO: Not a regression; the .dialog-title fix only covers the title. In the 'Join as {name}?' dialog the confirm button label is `Join as ${data.name}`, and .btn has white-space:nowrap (styles.css:602). On a 375px phone the dialog's content width is about 285px. With a 22–30 character member name such as 'Muhammad Abdullah Khan' (spaces don't help under nowrap), the button measures about 300–356px at weight 650. The button sticks out of the dialog and the modal shows a horizontal scrollbar. The dialog body, which shows the username (up to 30 characters, no spaces) and group names, has no overflow-wrap either, and also overflows on 320px screens.
  FIX: Add `.dialog-actions .btn { white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere; text-align: center; }` and `.dialog-body { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }`. Or use a short confirm label such as 'Join'.
